programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. programme.desc: When Tahsin decides to oppose Bulent and publish his war, many of his associates will leave him. However, Tahsin is determined in his intention. Sultan finally decided to get out of the house, even if it was in a wheelchair. With Gulten and Firato goes to a check-up, and later on the shore of the Bosphorus. Aziz gathers his people and tells them that the dangerous period is followed for them, because they must be opposed to a very dangerous and powerful man called Bulent. He doesn't even serve how much Bulent approached his family. Sa Gulten i Firatom odlazi na kontrolni pregled, a kasnije i na obalu Bosfora. Aziz okuplja svoje ljude i govori im da za njih slijedi opasan period, jer se moraju suprotstaviti veoma opasnom i moćnom čovjeku koji se zove Bulent. On ni ne sluti koliko se Bulent približio njegovoj porodici. Uloge: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Režija: Murat Onbul

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E35, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E35, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatian) Winter landscapes that simultaneously discover and hide their true nature will be our guides on a sentimental trip, searching for railway stripes that are already slightly disappearing from memory. The process of construction of state, vicinal and private stripes began in the 1970s: In the next few decades, the Croatian part of Baranja is overwhelmed by the rails that become a connection with the world and the flywheel of social and economic development. Namely, by its natural wealth, Baranja was a promised country. Large areas were covered with forests that intensively intensively intensively intensively during the 19th century. The tree, with considerable profit, exports, and the newly established cow -in are converted to agrarian areas that give an abundance of agricultural products. And this is where the railway pillar enables all these products, that is, the raw materials quickly and safely reach the customers, the good organization and the appropriate infrastructure was crucial for this complex and sensitive process whose important part was happening at railway stations. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska) Zimski krajolici koji istodobno otkrivaju i skrivaju svoju pravu prirodu bit će naši vodiči na sentimentalnom putovanju, potrazi za željezničkim prugama koje već pomalo nestaju i iz pamćenja. Proces izgradnje državnih, vicinalnih i privatnih pruga započinje sedamdesetih godina 19. stoljeća: u sljedećih nekoliko desetljeća hrvatski je dio Baranje premrežen tračnicama koje postaju veza sa svijetom i zamašnjak društvenog i ekonomskog razvoja. Baranja je, naime, po svom prirodnom bogatstvu bila obećana zemlja. Velike su površine bile pokrivene šumama koje se osobito tijekom 19. stoljeća intenzivno sijeku. Drvo se, uz znatan profit, izvozi, a novonastale se krčevine pretvaraju u agrarne površine koje daju obilje poljoprivrednih proizvoda. I tu na scenu stupa željeznica koja omogućava da svi ti proizvodi, odnosno, sirovine brzo i sigurno stignu do kupaca, dobra organizacija i primjerena infrastruktura bila je ključna za taj složeni i osjetljivi procesa čiji se važan dio zbivao na željezničkim postajama. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Nomada Diary / Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: Nomada Diary - (S01, E01, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2025) Kristijan Ilicic is a popular Travel Blogger, author of the traveling bestseller and the first Croat to visit all the countries of the world. In the "Nomada Diary", his first TV series, he moves with traces of legendary Karlovac researchers Mirko and Stjepan Seljan. The search for Africa revealed by the peasant brothers, more precisely, of what was left of her, Christian begins in Egypt, traveling from Cairo to the Red Sea. Then he goes to Ethiopia, where he avoids war danger and reveals the terrible secrets of Cedorism in the tribes in the south of the country. But at the same time, it represents Africa full of life and love, a continent that grows and progresses. Africa as the Seljan brothers knew in their legendary campaign from Alexandria to Ethiopia, then Abyssinia, today there are some brand new Africa, but the prints of the past are everywhere - Christian Koraca seeking interesting people and customs, embarking on an adventure of life full of memories of their own old trips, with new acquired experiences, knowledge and friendship. ------ the journey of Africa Christian begins in Egypt, driving on the hectic streets of Kairi, where the Seljan brothers hiked 125 years ago. He wants to try the traditional local specialty of Hamam Mashi - a stuffed pigeon. He is looking for him at an exotic local market and climbs high wooden pigeons on the tops of buildings, where she learns the techniques of pigeon hunting. Christian then visits the first Al-Azhar city mosque, allegedly built by a Croat, as well as a Christian monastery carved into Makkatam Hill and a cave church that can accommodate as many as 20,000 people. But in order to reach this church, it must go through the "city of garbage". Nothing can prepare him for "Garbage City", a ghetto in which Christian meets first -hand a difficult life of a unique community of Coptic Christians, people who live from city waste recycling, literally surrounded by garbage. R .: Dario Lonjak Ul.: Kristijan Ilicic (Self) ... / Dnevnik Nomada - (S01, E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2025) Kristijan Iličić je popularni travel blogger, autor putopisnog bestselera i prvi Hrvat koji je obišao sve zemlje svijeta. U "Dnevniku nomada", svojoj prvoj TV seriji, kreće tragovima legendarnih karlovačkih istraživača Mirka i Stjepana Seljana. Potragu za Afrikom kakvu su otkrivala braća Seljan, točnije, za onime što je ostalo od nje, Kristijan počinje u Egiptu, putujući od Kaira do Crvenog mora. Zatim odlazi u Etiopiju, gdje izbjegava ratne opasnosti i otkriva strašne tajne čedomorstva u plemenima na jugu zemlje. Ali u isto vrijeme, predstavlja Afriku punu života i ljubavi, kontinent koji raste i napreduje. Afrika kakvu su poznavala braća Seljan u svom legendarnom pohodu od Aleksandrije do Etiopije, tadašnje Abesinije, danas je neka potpuno nova Afrika, ali otisci prošlosti su posvuda - njima Kristijan korača tražeći zanimljive ljude i običaje, upuštajući se u avanturu života punu sjećanja na vlastita stara putovanja, uz nova stečena iskustva, znanja i prijateljstva. ----- Putovanje Afrikom Kristijan počinje u Egiptu, vožnjom po hektičnim ulicama Kaira, gdje su braća Seljan pješačila prije 125 godina. Želi probati tradicijski lokalni specijalitet hamam mashi - punjenog goluba. Traži ga na egzotičnoj lokalnoj tržnici i penje se na visoke drvene golubarnike na vrhovima zgrada, gdje uči tehnike lova na golubove. Kristijan zatim obilazi prvu gradsku džamiju Al-Azhar, koju je navodno izgradio Hrvat, kao i kršćanski samostan uklesan u brdo Mokattam i pećinsku crkvu koja može primiti čak 20.000 ljudi. Ali da bi došao do ove crkve, mora proći kroz "Grad smeća". Ništa ga ne može pripremiti za "Garbage City", geto u kojem Kristijan iz prve ruke upoznaje težak život jedinstvene zajednice koptskih kršćana, ljude koji žive od recikliranja gradskog otpada, doslovno okruženi smećem. programme.desc: Little Disasters - (E01, feature series, England, 2025) When the perfect housewife and mother Jess brings her daughter to a hospital with a head injury she does not know, her close friend and duty doctor at the LIZ emergency service must decide whether the case will report to the social service. One telephone call triggers an avalanche of events that threaten to destroy not only their families but also friendship. While police and social service threaten Jessa's life, and friends Mel and Charlotte are drawn into an investigation. Below the surface, there are more objections to each other that reveal more about them than Jess. All of them secretly bothers them the same question, "Am I a bad mother?" In search of the truth, everyone wonders what really happened to little Betsey and what Jessa's family hides. The shop is moving when Jess ran into an emergency with a 10 -month -old daughter in the middle of the night. Liz, surprised to see her longtime friend, recalls their acquaintance from the pregnancy course and years of mutual support - although they have recently begun to move away. The surprise soon grows into a shock when Liz discovers swelling on Betsey's head, and Jess offers a confusing and illogical explanation. After a CT examination that detects the severity of the injury, Liz makes a painful decision: to inform the social service. In the meantime, Jessa's husband Ed remains at home, unaware of what is happening, and is under extra pressure because she has to organize his son Frankie's eighth birthday celebration. Charlotte and Mel addresses help. But Jessini and Lizin's actions lead to dramatic consequences - police and social service appear on the birthday. programme.title: Mysterious Santorini / Tajanstveni Santorini
programme.desc: Das Geheimnis von Santorini - (Doc. Film, Germany, 2024) Santorini is an island with an explosive history. 3600 years ago, a volcano at his center erupted and destroyed the ancient island of Ter. His inhabitants left and cities were destroyed. The researchers have long wondered if the Minoan civilization of Santorini and Crete, which dominated the space of the Aegean Sea, lost its power because of this volcanic eruption and failed. The pioneering international scientific expedition wants to determine the exact course of the Minoan eruption and what it meant for the history of the Aegean Sea. For the first time, scientists are drilling miles of core samples from the bottom of the sea in the hope that they will discover the whole geological history of that ancient volcano and be able to predict its future activities and their consequences. The knowledge of scientists could provide us with a useful insight into the volcano with Santorini and similar volcanoes around the world. R .: Daniela Pulverer ... / Das Geheimnis von Santorini - (dok. film, Njemačka, 2024) Santorini je otok s eksplozivnom poviješću. Prije 3600 godina vulkan u njegovu središtu erumpirao je i uništio drevni otok Teru. Njegovi su stanovnici otišli, a gradovi su razoreni. Istraživači su se dugo pitali je li minojska civilizacija sa Santorinija i Krete, koja je dominirala prostorom Egejskog mora, zbog te vulkanske erupcije izgubila svoju moć i propala. Pionirska međunarodna znanstvena ekspedicija želi odrediti točan tijek minojske erupcije i što je ona značila za povijest Egejskog mora. Znanstvenici prvi put bušenjem vade kilometre uzoraka jezgre s dna mora u nadi da će otkriti cijelu geološku povijest tog drevnog vulkana i moći predvidjeti njegove buduće aktivnosti i njihove posljedice. Saznanja znanstvenika mogla bi nam pružiti koristan uvid u vulkan sa Santorinija i slične vulkane diljem svijeta. R.: Daniela Pulverer...

programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia) in medieval cities with surrounded walls where the space was valuable and carefully planned, there were usually no parks or larger green spaces. Thus, at the end of the 19th century, the Sibenik "Djardin" was created, a park that today bears the name of Robert Visiani, a botanist born here in 1800. If the beauty is the promise of happiness, the people of Sibenik really could be happy in their little oasis of greenery arranged by Italian public parks. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska) U srednjovjekovnim gradovima opasanim zidinama gdje je prostor bio dragocjen i pomno isplaniran obično nije bilo perivoja ni većih zelenih površina. Tek kada su bedemi i kule postali suvišni i kada su okolnosti to dopustile, mogle su se početi osvajati nove površine izvan povijesne jezgre. Tako je potkraj 19. stoljeća nastao i šibenski "đardin", perivoj koji danas nosi ime Roberta Visianija, botaničara rođenog ovdje 1800. godine. Ako je ljepota obećanje sreće, Šibenčani su doista mogli biti sretni u svojoj maloj oazi zelenila uređenoj po uzoru na talijanske javne parkove. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Nomada Diary / Dnevnik Nomada
programme.desc: Nomada Diary - (E01, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2025) Kristijan Ilicic is a popular Travel Blogger, author of a traveling bestseller and the first Croat to visit all countries of the world. In the "Nomada Diary", his first TV series, he moves with traces of legendary Karlovac researchers Mirko and Stjepan Seljan. The search for Africa revealed by the peasant brothers, more precisely, of what was left of her, Christian begins in Egypt, traveling from Cairo to the Red Sea. Then he goes to Ethiopia, where he avoids war danger and reveals the terrible secrets of Cedorism in the tribes in the south of the country. But at the same time, it represents Africa full of life and love, a continent that grows and progresses. Africa as the Seljan brothers knew in their legendary campaign from Alexandria to Ethiopia, then Abyssinia, today there are some brand new Africa, but the prints of the past are everywhere - Christian Koraca seeking interesting people and customs, embarking on an adventure of life full of memories of their own old trips, with new acquired experiences, knowledge and friendship. ------ the journey of Africa Christian begins in Egypt, driving on the hectic streets of Kairi, where the Seljan brothers hiked 125 years ago. He wants to try the traditional local specialty of Hamam Mashi - a stuffed pigeon. He is looking for him at an exotic local market and climbs high wooden pigeons on the tops of buildings, where she learns the techniques of pigeon hunting. Christian then visits the first Al-Azhar city mosque, allegedly built by a Croat, as well as a Christian monastery carved into Makkatam Hill and a cave church that can accommodate as many as 20,000 people. But in order to reach this church, it must go through the "city of garbage". Nothing can prepare him for "Garbage City", a ghetto in which Christian meets first -hand a difficult life of a unique community of Coptic Christians, people who live from city waste recycling, literally surrounded by garbage. R .: Dario Lonjak Ul.: Kristijan Ilicic (Self) ... / Dnevnik Nomada - (E01, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2025) Kristijan Iličić je popularni travel blogger, autor putopisnog bestselera i prvi Hrvat koji je obišao sve zemlje svijeta. U "Dnevniku nomada", svojoj prvoj TV seriji, kreće tragovima legendarnih karlovačkih istraživača Mirka i Stjepana Seljana. Potragu za Afrikom kakvu su otkrivala braća Seljan, točnije, za onime što je ostalo od nje, Kristijan počinje u Egiptu, putujući od Kaira do Crvenog mora. Zatim odlazi u Etiopiju, gdje izbjegava ratne opasnosti i otkriva strašne tajne čedomorstva u plemenima na jugu zemlje. Ali u isto vrijeme, predstavlja Afriku punu života i ljubavi, kontinent koji raste i napreduje. Afrika kakvu su poznavala braća Seljan u svom legendarnom pohodu od Aleksandrije do Etiopije, tadašnje Abesinije, danas je neka potpuno nova Afrika, ali otisci prošlosti su posvuda - njima Kristijan korača tražeći zanimljive ljude i običaje, upuštajući se u avanturu života punu sjećanja na vlastita stara putovanja, uz nova stečena iskustva, znanja i prijateljstva. ----- Putovanje Afrikom Kristijan počinje u Egiptu, vožnjom po hektičnim ulicama Kaira, gdje su braća Seljan pješačila prije 125 godina. Želi probati tradicijski lokalni specijalitet hamam mashi - punjenog goluba. Traži ga na egzotičnoj lokalnoj tržnici i penje se na visoke drvene golubarnike na vrhovima zgrada, gdje uči tehnike lova na golubove. Kristijan zatim obilazi prvu gradsku džamiju Al-Azhar, koju je navodno izgradio Hrvat, kao i kršćanski samostan uklesan u brdo Mokattam i pećinsku crkvu koja može primiti čak 20.000 ljudi. Ali da bi došao do ove crkve, mora proći kroz "Grad smeća". Ništa ga ne može pripremiti za "Garbage City", geto u kojem Kristijan iz prve ruke upoznaje težak život jedinstvene zajednice koptskih kršćana, ljude koji žive od recikliranja gradskog otpada, doslovno okruženi smećem. R.: Dario Lonjak Ul.: Kristijan Ilicic (Self)...

programme.title: Velike Pustolovine: South America with Nick Knowles / Velike pustolovine: Južna Amerika s Nickom Knowlesom
programme.desc: Nick Knowles in South America - (E01, Nature. Film, England, 2024) Nick Knowles opened the series hanging on a 30 -meter -high rock. It is among the low slopes of magnificent Andes and in an exciting way begins its South American adventure. Crossing Magellan's passage to the tiny, desolate island of Magdalen, Nick will be among the 40,000 couples of Magellan's penguins in the middle of the mating season. Southern Patagonia has long been a magnet for researchers. After Magellana, who first sailed the world, Charles Darwin came here 300 years later on the ship of HMS Beagle and changed the way we see the world around us. Nick will visit replicas in full size of both, surprisingly small ships. The Kaweshkas tribe is known for its deep connection with the ocean. Nick will learn their knitting style and find out how their ancestors embarked on incredible navigation to the ocean. Chile is one of the most voyage countries in the world, and Nicka will be delighted with the factory that is practically carbon neutral while produces hydrogen -based fuel by exploiting wind energy. R .: Ben Southwell ... / Nick Knowles in South America - (E01, prirod. film, Engleska, 2024) Nick Knowles seriju otvara viseći na stijeni visokoj 30 metara. Nalazi se među niskim padinama veličanstvenih Anda i na uzbudljiv način započinje svoju južnoameričku pustolovinu. Prešavši Magellanov prolaz do sićušnog, pustog otoka Magdalena, Nick će se naći među 40.000 parova Magellanovih pingvina usred sezone parenja. Južna Patagonija već je dugo magnet za istraživače. Nakon Magellana koji je prvi oplovio svijet, Charles Darwin je 300 godina poslije došao ovamo na brodu HMS Beagle i promijenio način na koji vidimo svijet oko nas. Nick će posjetiti replike u punoj veličini oba, iznenađujuće mala broda. Pleme Kaweshkas poznato je po svojoj dubokoj povezanosti s oceanom. Nick će učiti njihov stil pletenja i doznati kako su se njihovi preci upuštali u nevjerojatne plovidbe oceanom. Čile je jedna od najvjetrovitijih zemalja svijeta, a Nicka će oduševiti tvornica koja je praktički ugljično neutralna dok proizvodi gorivo na bazi vodika iskorištavajući energiju vjetra. R.: Ben Southwell...

programme.title: Without a screen: a school that banned cell phones / Bez ekrana: Škola koja je zabranila mobitele
programme.desc: Swiped: The School That Banned Smartphones - (E01, Educational Program, England, 2024) without screen. Without social networks. Without a security network. Can school endure 21 days without smartphones? We follow the social experiment that explores the actual impact of smartphones on young people. This two -piece documentary deals with the current question of the influence of smartphones on the baby's brain and behavior. The problem of increasing young people's dependencies about smartphones exceeds geographical and cultural barriers and encourages a discussion of a suitable age to access this technology. The authors of the film, Matt and Emma Willis, join forces with Stanway school in Colchester. Together with a group of students, they will accept the challenge and give up smartphones for 21 days. We follow the participants from start to the end of the experiment - we will hear interviews with participants and their video diaries and scientists' comments. The hosts will talk to various experts (doctors, state officials, etc.) about the impact of smartphones on children, and will visit parents whose children died after being exposed to dangerous content on social networks. R .: Mark Drake Ul.: Emma Willis (Self), Matt Willis (Self) ... / Swiped: The School That Banned Smartphones - (E01, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2024) Bez ekrana. Bez društvenih mreža. Bez sigurnosne mreže. Može li škola izdržati 21 dan bez pametnih telefona? Pratimo društveni eksperiment koji istražuje stvarni utjecaj pametnih telefona na mlade. Ovaj dvodijelni dokumentarac bavi se aktualnim pitanjem utjecaja pametnih telefona na dječji mozak i ponašanje. Problem sve veće ovisnosti mladih o pametnim telefonima prelazi zemljopisne i kulturne barijere te potiče raspravu o prikladnoj dobi za pristup toj tehnologiji. Autori filma, Matt i Emma Willis, udružuju snage sa školom Stanway u Colchesteru. Zajedno sa skupinom učenika prihvatit će izazov i odreći se pametnih telefona na 21 dan. Pratimo sudionike od početka do kraja eksperimenta - čut ćemo intervjue sa sudionicima i njihove video dnevnike te komentare znanstvenika. Domaćini će razgovarati s različitim stručnjacima (liječnicima, državnim dužnosnicima itd.) o utjecaju pametnih telefona na djecu, a posjetit će i roditelje čija su djeca umrla nakon što su bila izložena opasnom sadržaju na društvenim mrežama. programme.title: AGATHE CHRISTIE TRAVELS WITH SIR David Suchet / Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E01, Tourist Program, England, 2025) In 1922, long before she became the best -selling author in the world, Agatha Christie embarked on an exciting world trip. Now, 100 years later, Sir David Suchet, who played Poirota, goes in her footsteps. On her incredible adventure, Agatha traveled through the then British Empire and visited South Africa, Australia, New Zealand and Canada, and spent a vacation in Hawaii. Armed with her trusted camera that will perpetuate her travels, Sir David will watch what she saw, what will give him insight into how that journey influenced her life and her literary work and will discover the unknown sides of her character. The way people understand Agath Christie is usually overshadowed by her public person she held in later life, when they considered her shy and withdrawn. But it was only a defensive wall that Agatha raised around her, and Sir David will discover her completely different character on her journey: a curious and carefree young woman who seems to become more and more self -conscious and more independent. In 1922, Agatha was only 31 years old and just started her literary journey. But by the time she returned home, they declared her one of the brightest young talents of the time. Agath's global journey happened because she and her husband Archie were part of a special mission in charge of promoting the upcoming exhibition of the British Empire. Held in London in 1924, designed to encourage the trade and strengthen ties among various nations. In addition to exploring Agath's past, Sir David will deal with the fascinating history of the countries she has visited. She will find that the situation has changed in a hundred years since her trip and will see that different communities are struggling with complex inheritance of colonialism and how to transform it ... / Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E01, turistički program, Engleska, 2025) Godine 1922., mnogo prije nego što je postala najprodavanija autorica na svijetu, Agatha Christie krenula je na uzbudljivo svjetsko putovanje. Sada, 100 godina poslije, sir David Suchet, koji je glumio Poirota, ide njezinim stopama. Na svojoj nevjerojatnoj pustolovini Agatha je putovala kroz tadašnje Britansko Carstvo te je posjetila Južnu Afriku, Australiju, Novi Zeland i Kanadu, a provela je i odmor na Havajima. Naoružan svojim pouzdanim fotoaparatom kojim će ovjekovječiti svoja putovanja, sir David će gledati ono što je ona vidjela, što će mu pružiti uvid u to kako je to putovanje utjecalo na njezin život i njezin književni rad te će otkriti nepoznate strane njezina karaktera. Način na koji ljudi poimaju Agathu Christie obično je zasjenjen njezinom javnom osobom koju je održavala u kasnijem životu, kada su je smatrali sramežljivom i povučenom. No to je bio tek obrambeni zid koji je Agatha podigla oko sebe, a sir David će na svojem putovanju otkriti njezin sasvim drukčiji lik: znatiželjnu i bezbrižnu mladu ženu koja je, čini se, postajala sve samosvjesnija i neovisnija. Godine 1922. Agatha je imala samo 31 godinu i tek je počinjala svoje književno putovanje. No, do trenutka kada se vratila kući, proglasili su je jednim od najsjajnijih mladih talenata toga doba. Agathino globalno putovanje dogodilo se jer su ona i njezin suprug Archie bili dio posebne misije zadužene za promicanje nadolazeće Izložbe Britanskog Carstva. Održana u Londonu 1924. godine, osmišljena je kako bi potaknula trgovinu i ojačala veze među raznim narodima. Osim što će istražiti Agathinu prošlost, sir David će se baviti fascinantnom poviješću zemalja koje je posjetila. Otkrit će kako se situacija promijenila u sto godina od njezina putovanja i vidjet će kako se različite zajednice bore sa složenim nasljeđem kolonijalizma te kako ga transformiraju...

programme.title: Location, location, location / Lokacija, lokacija, lokacija
programme.desc: Location, Location, Location - (S27, E14, Doc. Film, England) In this episode, we will again visit two pairs that were most important to be close to family. In 2011, Rupreet and Sundeep decided to move. They were married for 18 months and, in accordance with tradition, lived with Sundeep's family. But it took longer than they expected because the search for their first home did not flow smoothly. Rupreet wanted a house in an elite location and gave Kirstie a strict instructions on which fourth Harrow came into account. They wanted to live close to their families, so it was not difficult for them to engage in adaptation. And in 2021, after living in Sydney for six years, Laura and Euan decided to return to Glasgow to make their children closer to their grandparents. After a long break, they were torn between the purchase of an apartment in the trendy West End or a family home a little farther from the city ... / Location, Location, Location - (S27, E14, dok. film, Engleska) U ovoj epizodi ponovno ćemo obići dva para kojima je bilo najvažnije da su blizu obitelji. Godine 2011. Rupreet i Sundeep odlučili su se preseliti. Bili su u braku 18 mjeseci i, u skladu s tradicijom, živjeli sa Sundeepovom obitelji. No to je potrajalo duže nego što su očekivali jer potraga za njihovim prvim domom nije tekla glatko. Rupreet je htjela kuću na elitnoj lokaciji i dala Kirstie stroge upute o tome koje četvrti Harrowa dolaze u obzir. Htjeli su živjeti blizu svojih obitelji pa im je nije bilo teško upustiti se u adaptaciju. A 2021., nakon što su šest godina živjeli u Sydneyju, Laura i Euan odlučili su se vratiti u Glasgow kako bi njihova djeca bila bliže baki i djedu. Nakon dugog izbivanja, bili su rastrzani između kupnje stana u trendovskom West Endu ili obiteljske kuće malo dalje od grada...

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Design - Australia / Čudesni svijet dizajna - Australija
programme.desc: Grand Designs Australia - (S11, E06, known. Pop. Series, Australia, 2024) The teacher I grew up on a sheep farm of 240 hectares near Canberre and dreams of returning home for himself, his wife Selina and three sons with his parents and brother's house. The home would be self -sustaining, built of 14,000 recycled red Kanberic bricks that are so rare today that they became the target of antiques. Of course, he cannot buy them, but he can collect on construction sites with demolished houses around the capital. Winter arrived, and their crisis does not support them. House prices fall and they cannot sell their house where they have lived until then. That is why they move into a cottage they built during the Kovida and that is no bigger than a camp house, no running water and the toilet is out of the house. The construction of the Kanberian brick house has progressed so much that they can no longer stand with the works and which, if they ever finish it, would be an eternal home to their autistic son Sebastian. For the first eight years of life, Sebastian did not speak at all, and now, at the age of 12, he dreams of becoming a farmer one day. Ul.: Anthony Burke (Self - Present) ... / Grand Designs Australia - (S11, E06, znan. pop. serija, Australija, 2024) Učitelj Sam odrastao je na ovčarskoj farmi od 240 hektara blizu Canberre i sanja da se onamo vrati i sagradi dom za sebe, ženu Selinu i tri sina uz kuću svojih roditelja i brata. Dom bi bio samoodrživ, sagrađen od 14.000 recikliranih crvenih kanberskih opeka koje su danas toliko rijetke da su postale meta skupljača starina. Sam ih, dakako, ne može kupiti, ali može skupljati na gradilištima sa srušenim kućama oko glavnoga grada. Stigla je zima, a ni kriza im ne ide u prilog. Cijene kuća padaju i oni ne mogu prodati svoju kuću u kojoj su dotad živjeli. Zato se sele u kućicu koju su sagradili tijekom kovida i koja nije veća od kamp kućice, nema tekuće vode i WC je izvan kuće. Gradnja kuće od kanberske cigle toliko je napredovala da više ne mogu stati s radovima i koja bi, budu li je ikada završili, bila vječni dom njihovu autističnom sinu Sebastianu. Prvih osam godina života Sebastian nije uopće govorio, a sada, s 12 godina, sanja da i sam jednog dana postane farmer. Ul.: Anthony Burke (Self - Presenter)...

And from the safety of his kitchen, Rick reveals to us that as a young man on the Lizard Peninsula, he fell in love for the first time and tasted the French fish soup, Bouillabaisse for the first time. U krajoliku obavijenom maglom Rick kreće u potragu za najstarijom građevinom u Cornwallu. A iz sigurnosti svoje kuhinje Rick nam otkriva kako se kao mladić na poluotoku Lizard prvi put zaljubio i prvi put kušao francusku riblju juhu, bouillabaisse. R.: Matt Bennett...

programme.desc: Grand Designs Australia - (S11, E06, known. Pop. Series, Australia, 2024) The teacher I grew up on a sheep farm of 240 hectares near Canberre and dreams of returning home for himself, his wife Selina and three sons with his parents and brother's house. The home would be self -sustaining, built of 14,000 recycled red Kanberic bricks that are so rare today that they became the target of antiques. Of course, he cannot buy them, but he can collect on construction sites with demolished houses around the capital. Winter arrived, and their crisis does not support them. House prices fall and they cannot sell their house where they have lived until then. That is why they move into a cottage they built during the Kovida and that is no bigger than a camp house, no running water and the toilet is out of the house. The construction of the Kanberian brick house has progressed so much that they can no longer stand with the works and which, if they ever finish it, would be an eternal home to their autistic son Sebastian. Dom bi bio samoodrživ, sagrađen od 14.000 recikliranih crvenih kanberskih opeka koje su danas toliko rijetke da su postale meta skupljača starina. Sam ih, dakako, ne može kupiti, ali može skupljati na gradilištima sa srušenim kućama oko glavnoga grada. Stigla je zima, a ni kriza im ne ide u prilog. Cijene kuća padaju i oni ne mogu prodati svoju kuću u kojoj su dotad živjeli. Zato se sele u kućicu koju su sagradili tijekom kovida i koja nije veća od kamp kućice, nema tekuće vode i WC je izvan kuće. Gradnja kuće od kanberske cigle toliko je napredovala da više ne mogu stati s radovima i koja bi, budu li je ikada završili, bila vječni dom njihovu autističnom sinu Sebastianu. Prvih osam godina života Sebastian nije uopće govorio, a sada, s 12 godina, sanja da i sam jednog dana postane farmer. Ul.: Anthony Burke (Self - Presenter)...

Riječ je o izvedbi skladbe Glorija, velikog Borisa Papandopula, napisane davne 1983., ali nikada prije javno izvedene, niti snimljene. Drugi dio koncerta predstavlja Festivalski komorni orkestar s kojim nastupaju tri mlade solistice čije su karijere u usponu. Među njima je svakako najpoznatija iznimno nadarena hrvatska sopranistica Josipa Bilić. U završnici koncerta ona izvodi Čardaš ariju iz Kálmánove operete Grofica Marica, pjevajući je u prepjevu na hrvatskom jeziku - dodatna zanimljivost za koncert održan u Sloveniji. Uz vrhunsku izvedbu osobito je dojmljivo njezino kretanje na sceni, koje odlično prati kamera, te je vizualni i emocionalni doživljaj izvedbe još snažniji...

programme.title: Conference in Wannsee / Konferencija u Wannseeu
programme.desc: Die Wannseeemkon Pljesee - film, Germany, 2022) on January 20, 1942. That meeting went history as a conference in Wannsee. It was decided to systematically kill 11 million Jews. On January 20, 1942, high representatives of the Nazi regime met at an idyllic villa in Wannsee southwest of Berlin. That meeting has entered history as a conference in Wannsee. Due to the conversations they have led, the number of victims and the consequences may be the worst conference in human history. It was attended by 15 SS leading people, the National Socialist Party and Bureaucracy. They were invited by Reinhard Heydrich, head of the secret police and security service. They were supposed to be at breakfast and a meeting. The exclusive topic of the meeting, which lasted about 90 minutes, was what the Nazis called by the final solution of the Jewish issue. They needed bureaucratically to organize a systematic killing of millions of Jews across Europe. This television film was made on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the maintenance of this historic event. It is based on the minutes of the Adolf Eichmann meeting. R.: Matti Geschonneck Ul.: Philipp Hochmair (Reinhard Heydrich), Johannes Allmayer (Adolf Eichmann), Markus Schleinzer (Otto Hofmann), Jakob Diehl (Heinrich Muller), Maximilian Bruckner / Die Wannseekonferenz - (film, Njemačka, 2022) 20. siječnja 1942. glavni predstavnici nacističkog režima sastali su se u vili u berlinskom Wannseeu. Taj je sastanak ušao u povijest kao konferencija u Wannseeu. Na njoj je odlučeno kako će sustavno ubiti 11 milijuna Židova. 20. siječnja 1942. visoki predstavnici nacističkog režima sastali su se u idiličnoj vili u Wannseeu jugozapadno od Berlina. Taj je sastanak u povijest ušao kao konferencija u Wannseeu. Zbog razgovora koje su vodili, broja žrtava i posljedica možda je i najgora konferencija u povijesti čovječanstva. Na njoj je prisustvovalo 15 vodećih ljudi SS-a, Nacionalsocijalističke stranke i birokracije. Pozvao ih je Reinhard Heydrich, šef tajne policije i sigurnosne službe. Trebali su se naći na doručku i sastanku. Isključiva tema sastanka, koji je trajao otprilike 90 minuta, bilo je ono što su nacisti nazivali Konačnim rješenjem židovskog pitanja. Trebali su birokratski organizirati sustavno ubijanje milijuna Židova diljem Europe. Ovaj je televizijski film snimljen povodom 80-godišnjice održavanja tog povijesnog događaja. Temelji se na zapisniku sastanka Adolfa Eichmanna. R.: Matti Geschonneck Ul.: Philipp Hochmair (Reinhard Heydrich), Johannes Allmayer (Adolf Eichmann), Markus Schleinzer (Otto Hofmann), Jakob Diehl (Heinrich Muller), Maximilian Bruckner (Dr. Eberhard Schongarth)...

Govorimo i o kajkavskom, štokavskom i čakavskom narječju te neobičnim imenima mjesta, ali i o čestim i neobičnim osobnim imenima i prezimenima. programme.title: Beggar / Berač kamena
programme.desc: Stone Picker - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2005) in the vicinity of Benkovac, on Mount Bukovica, in the village of Popovici, there is one of the last handicraft "stone pickers". He pulls out the stone, but not with machines, but it does it by using exclusively tools on a "muscle" drive - Kramp, a shovel, a lever and his own hands, going to his "coffee" (quarry), at the time of the greatest summer heat. This way of doing the job is not a technophobic whim, nor with machines irreplaceable job technology. Only metal banging on stone, ringing already extracted stone slabs, crickets from the surrounding area and heavy breathing of workers. R .: Branko Istvancic ... / Berač kamena - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2005) U okolici Benkovca, na planini Bukovica, u selu Popovići, živi jedan od posljednjih vlastoručnih "berača kamena". On vadi kamen, ali ne strojevima, već to radi koristeći isključivo oruđe na "mišićni" pogon - kramp, lopatu, polugu i vlastite ruke, odlaskom u svoju "kavu" (kamenolom), i to u vrijeme najveće ljetne žege. Ovakav način obavljanja posla nije nikakav tehnofobični hir, niti strojevima nenadomjestiva tehnologija posla. Čuje se samo lupanje metala po kamenu, zvonjenje već izvađenih kamenih ploča, cvrčci iz okolice i teško disanje radnika. R.: Branko Ištvančić...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia) In a time that does not benefit, especially cultural programs and content related to jazz, to mark a quarter of a century of existence of a jazz festival is an event that wakes up optimism. Opatija Liburnia Jazz Festival, which celebrated its 25 years from the 4th to the 6th of July, is first and foremost important as the first large step into the world of jazz for local musicians. Aside from the opportunity to meet with jazz at all, to get on him as listeners, the festival gave them the opportunity not only to perform on it, but also to share the stage with some of the world's greats, such as Joe Zawinul, Hiromi, Mike Stern, Richard Bon, Maria Joao, Medeski, Martin and Wood Gallianoa. This special year, the festival particularly emphasized its role as a meeting place in the broad sense - local and foreign musicians, various cultures and music traditions, which was always an important component to him, and then music and different audiences. The concerts of the local forces of the Dragon Orko Star, as well as the Jazz Ex Tempore Orchestra, were held, composed of six musicians from the United Kingdom, Egypt, the Netherlands and Indonesia, Bulgaria and Croatia. Along with them, Lela and Joe Kaplowitz on the jazz boat performed at the festival, while the jazz sailed Techno Vikings and the Albe Nazinich and Lea Skec Quartet outside the genre borders. The tradition of Evergrine was in charge of the Lovran orchestra, with the famous Opatija face, Dusko Jelicic Duleta, and especially the performance of Elvis Stanic French Touch at the Older House in Volosko. To provide all generations with music, they provided workshops for the youngest, where preschool and school -age children were introduced to the rhythm and other basic elements of music. The presentation of the monograph, which remains as a document of this festival, as a document of this festival, as pointed out by its initiator and artistic director, guitarist, accordion player and composer Elvi ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) U vremenu koje ne pogoduje trajanju, osobito kulturnih programa i sadržaja vezanih uz jazz, obilježiti četvrt stoljeća postojanja nekog jazz festivala događaj je koji budi optimizam. Opatijski Liburnia Jazz Festival, koji je svojih 25 godina proslavio od 4. do 6. srpnja prije svega je važan kao prva velika stepenica u svijet jazza za lokalne muzičare. Osim prilike da se s jazzom uopće i susretnu, da se na njega kao slušatelji navuku, festival im je davao priliku ne samo da na njoj nastupe nego i da dijele pozornicu s nekima od svjetskih velikana, kao što su Joe Zawinul, Hiromi, Mike Stern, Richard Bona, Maria Joao, Medeski, Martin and Wood i brojni drugi, uključujući i prošlogodišnjeg gosta Richarda Gallianoa. Ove, posebne godine festival je posebno naglasio svoju ulogu kao mjesta susreta u širem smislu - lokalnih i inozemnih muzičara, različitih kultura i muzičkih tradicija, što mu je uvijek bila važna komponenta, a zatim i glazbe i različitih publika. Održali su se tako koncerti lokalnih snaga Zmaj Orko Star, ali i orkestra Jazz Ex Tempore, sastavljenog od šestoro glazbenica i glazbenika iz Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, Egipta, Nizozemske i Indonezije, Bugarske te Hrvatske. Uz njih su na festivalu nastupili i Lela i Joe Kaplowitz na Jazz Boatu, dok su izvan žanrovskih granica jazza otplovili Techno Vikings i kvartet Albe Nacinovich i Lea Škeca. Za tradiciju evergrina zaduženi su bili Puhaći orkestar Lovran uz poznato opatijsko lice, Duška Jeličića Duleta, a posebno vrijedi istaknuti nastup Elvis Stanić French Toucha u Domu za starije u Voloskom. Da se svim generacijama osigura dodir s glazbom omogućile su radionice za najmlađe, na kojima su se djeca predškolske i školske dobi upoznavala s ritmom i drugim osnovnim elementima glazbe. Svemu je prethodilo i predstavljanje monografije koja ostaje kao dokument trajanja ovog festivala, kao što je istaknuo i njegov pokretač i umjetnički direktor, gitarist, harmonikaš i kompozitor Elvi...

programme.title: Minority mosaic / Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: Minority mosaic - (educational film, Croatia, 2025) Baranja. Beli Manastir. Folklore. Tradition. All this and much more have combined into their work members of the Folklore Ensemble "Guardians of the Tradition of Baranja Serbs" from Beli Manastir. In a time that flies and does not allow memories, they have decided to pull manual and turn to the values ​​that have built some past generations. That's why not only dancers dressed in costumes. They cook fish and shepherds, grow old varieties, keep wine cellars, help each other in Polish affairs. And they attract children who persistently prove that their world is not just the Internet ... / Manjinski mozaik - (obrazovni film, Hrvatska, 2025) Baranja. Beli Manastir. Folklor. Tradicija. Sve to i još mnogo više spojili su u svoj rad članovi Folklornog ansambla "Čuvari tradicije baranjskih Srba" iz Belog Manastira. U vremenu koje leti i ne dopušta sjećanja, oni su odlučili povući ručnu i okrenuti se vrijednostima koje su izgradile neke prošle generacije. Pa zato i nisu samo i jedino plesači odjeveni u nošnju. Kuhaju fiš i čobanac, uzgajaju stare sorte, čuvaju vinske podrume, međusobno si pomažu u poljskim poslovima. I privlače djecu koja uporno dokazuju da njihov svijet nije samo internet...

programme.title: Maze / Labirint
programme.desc: Labyrinth - (Talk Show, Croatia) in the heart of our granary, fertile Slavonia and Baranja, from Andrijasevci to Novi Ceminac after the wheat harvest instead of joy - silence and bitterness. So it was this summer! In the land of galloping inflation, the purchase price of wheat has not changed for decades. Moreover, the question echoes - then why do we eat such expensive bread? The documentary film "Grain of Truth" indicates the absurdity of Croatian agriculture, which becomes impact news only when the peasants protest and perform tractors from the field on the roads. Why does homemade wheat export for small money, while expensive to sell imports of imported baker's products that have flooded our market? Why, even though we have produced cheap homemade wheat for decades, we pay more expensive and more expensive bread, those whose efforts melt on the way from field to table. The answers to the questions of why the peasant fails, the traders make money, and the state is silent as the strategies and the line ministers are unsuccessfully changing, in the first edition of this season's Labyrinth, the author Sanja Mikleušević Pavić is sought. R .: Slavica Grahovar ... / Labirint - (talk show, Hrvatska) U srcu naše žitnice, plodne Slavonije i Baranje, od Andrijaševaca do Novog Čeminca nakon žetve pšenice umjesto veselja - tišina i gorčina. Tako je bilo i ovoga ljeta! U zemlji galopirajuće inflacije otkupna cijena pšenice desetljećima se nije mijenjala. Tim više odzvanja pitanje - zašto onda jedemo tako skup kruh? Dokumentarni film "Zrno istine" ukazuje na apsurd hrvatske poljoprivrede koji postaje udarna vijest tek kada seljaci prosvjeduju i izvedu traktore s polja na ceste. Zašto domaća pšenica ide u izvoz za sitne novce, dok nam skupo prodaju uvozne pekarske proizvode koji su preplavili naše tržište? Zašto, iako već desetljećima proizvodimo jeftinu domaću pšenicu, plaćamo sve skuplji i skuplji kruh, govore oni čiji se trud topi na putu od polja do stola. Odgovore na pitanja zašto seljak propada, trgovci zarađuju, a država šuti dok bezuspješno mijenja strategije i resorne ministre, u prvom izdanju ovosezonskog Labirinta traži autorica Sanja Mikleušević Pavić. R.: Slavica Grahovar...

programme.title: Handball (M): Handball League - matches / Håndbold (m): Håndboldligaen - Kampe
programme.desc: Two teams with something to prove dry together in a match that can be decisive for their season start. North Zealand Handball is chasing stability after an uneven introduction, while the promoters from High Elite dream of showing that they are among the best. Both teams are hungry for points - but only one can take home the two vital. Will it be the routine of North Zealand or the promotion from Høj that prevails? / To hold med noget at bevise tørner sammen i en kamp, der kan blive afgørende for deres sæsonstart. Nordsjælland Håndbold jagter stabilitet efter en ujævn indledning, mens oprykkerne fra HØJ Elite drømmer om at vise, at de hører til blandt de bedste. Begge mandskaber hungrer efter point – men kun et kan tage de to livsvigtige med hjem. Bliver det rutinen fra Nordsjælland eller oprykkergejsten fra HØJ, der sejrer?

programme.title: Just My Luck / Just My Luck
programme.desc: In Manhattan, it is known that (Ashley Ulbright) is a fortunate and very successful woman in her work, and on the contrary (Jake Harden) is a poorly fortunate director of the Rock music band, and tries to contact (Damon Phillips) to strengthen his band, but to no avail, and when (Jake) meet (Ashley) at a disguise party, he exchanges a kiss, and with her also exchanged luck Good! / في مانهاتن، من المعروف أن (آشلي أولبرايت) إمرأة محظوظة وناجحة جدًا في عملها، وعلى العكس (جيك هاردن) مدير سيء الحظ لفرقة موسيقى روك، ويحاول الإتصال ب(دامون فيليبس) ليعزز فرقته، لكن دون جدوى، وعندما يلتقي (جيك) بـ(آشلي) في حفلة تنكرية، يتبادل معها قبلة، ومعها أيضًا تبادل حظه السيء وأخذ هو الحظ الجيد!

programme.title: Bedazzled / Bedazzled
programme.desc: Elliot Richards is not good at dealing with women. He is in the love of his beautiful colleague, but she does not feel the foundation. Elliot wished one day to do anything to reach the girl he loves. Suddenly, a beautiful and charming woman shows him as she presents herself as Satan; and that she came to offer him an attractive offer, to fulfill seven wishes he requests in exchange for selling her soul. Elliot finds her an opportunity to win the heart of his girlfriend, and we start watching seven wonderful adventures that he goes to The love of his life. / لا يجيد إليوت ريتشاردز التعامل مع النساء. يقع في حب زميلته الجميلة، ولكنها لا تشعر بوجوده من الأساس . يتمنى إليوت ذات يومٍ أن يفعل أي شيءٍ من أجل الوصول للفتاة التي يحبها.تظهر له فجأة امرأةٌ جميلةٌ وفاتنةٌ حيث تقدم نفسها باعتبارها الشيطان؛وأنها أتت لتعرض عليه عرضًا مغريًا، أن تحقق له سبع أمنياتٍ يطلبها في مقابل أن يبيع لها روحه.يجدها إليوت فرصةً سانحةً للفوز بقلب حبيبته، ونبدأ في مشاهدة سبع مغامراتٍ عجيبةٍ يخوضها إليوت بهدف الوصول إلى حب حياته.

programme.title: The Shape of Water / The Shape of Water
programme.desc: In a fictional story that takes place during the Cold War era, and in one of the ultra -secret factories of the government, Elisa lives in a full life of unity and silence within the factory, and her life changes forever when she discovers with her colleague Zelda is a very secret scientific experience, the axis of a unique water object. / في حكاية خيالية تجري أحداثها خلال حقبة الحرب الباردة، وفي إحدى المعامل فائقة السرية التابعة للحكومة، تعيش إليسا حياة كاملة من الوحدة والصمت داخل المعمل، وتتغير حياتها للأبد حينما تكتشف مع زميلتها زيلدا أمر تجربة علمية شديدة السرية، محورها كائن مائي فريد من نوعه.

programme.title: Tas Kagit Scissors / Tas Kagit Makas
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, a patient with a patient with Alzheimer's patients is accused of death, and his son with supernatural memory must help him, because he has become his last hope to survive, and to prove his innocence in the face of a family with great influence in Istanbul. / في إطار درامي، يتعرض عامل نظافة مريض بالزهايمر لاتهام بالقتل، ويجب على ابنه صاحب الذاكرة الخارقة أن يساعده، لأنه أصبح أمله الأخير في النجاة، وإثبات براءته في مواجهة عائلة لديها نفوذ كبير في إسطنبول.

programme.title: Home 12 / منزل 12
programme.desc: Munira has an extraordinary sense that makes her see things from other worlds, so she helps people with that sense, until her young son Saqr dies in a car accident, so she turns her life upside down and decided to stay away from everything, and lives a quiet life with her husband Muhammad, but the appearance of her neighbor Nadia in their lives changes the conditions to the unimaginable consequences. / تمتلك منيرة حاسة غير عادية تجعلها ترى أشياء من العوالم الأخرى، فتساعد الناس بتلك الحاسة، إلى أن يتوفى ابنها الصغير صقر في حادث سيارة، فتنقلب حياتها رأسا على عقب وتقرر الابتعاد عن كل شيء، وتحيا حياة هادئة مع زوجها محمد، إلا أن ظهور جارتها نادية في حياتهما يبدل الأحوال إلى ما لا يحمد عقباه.

programme.title: Pariersii / Parineetii
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where fate leads two friends close to marriage to the same man, which leads to many difficulties with the emergence of a complex love triangle, and the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقود القدر صديقتين مقربتين للزواج من نفس الرجل، مما يؤدي إلى العديد من الصعوبات مع ظهور مثلث حب معقد، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: earthquake / زلزال

programme.title: Saraya Abdin Part 1 / سرايا عابدين ج1
programme.desc: In a historical template, the series revolves during the period of the rule of Khedive Ismail to Egypt, and inside Saray Abdin, where the conflict and competition are raged within the harem in order to gain the satisfaction of the Khedive Ismail (Qusai Khouli), and he stands in this struggle (Nelly Karim), the wife of Khedive with Circassian origin, and his mother, Queen Khoshbar (Yusra), as well It revolves around the Khedive. / في قالب تاريخي، تدور أحداث المسلسل خلال فترة حكم الخديوي اسماعيل لمصر، وداخل سراي عابدين، حيث يحتدم الصراع والتنافس داخل أرجاء الحريم من أجل كسب رضا الخديوي إسماعيل (قصي خولي)، ويقف في هذا الصراع جلنار (نيللي كريم) زوجة الخديوي ذات الأصول الشركسية ، ووالدته الملكة خوشبار (يسرا)، وكذلك مع جواريه، كما يتطرق المسلسل للتوترات السياسية التي تدور حول الخديوي.

programme.title: Or forty -four / أم أربعة وأربعين
programme.desc: Eight women of forty -four years of age are engaged in many life challenges together, at the family, emotional and professional levels, and each of them seeks to enhance stability in her life at all levels, and achieve her aspirations before it is too late. / تخوض ثماني نساء في الرابعة والأربعين من العمر العديد من التحديات الحياتية معًا، على المستوى الأسري والعاطفي والمهني، وتسعى كل واحدة منهن لتعزيز الاستقرار في حياتها على كافة الأصعدة، وتحقيق طموحاتها قبل فوات الأوان.

programme.title: Love game / لعبة حب
programme.desc: A wealthy young man is in love with a poor girl, then he later discovers that his relative and grandfather are the ones who pushed the money to the girl to take advantage of her need, in order to sign him in her net and marry her, and the events follow. / يقع شاب ثري في حب فتاة فقيرة، ثم يكتشف لاحقًا أن قريبته وجده هما من دفعا المال إلى الفتاة استغلالًا لاحتياجها، لكي توقعه في شباكها ويتزوجها، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Cairo batch / دفعة القاهرة
programme.desc: The series deals with the stories of a group of Kuwaiti female students, during their studies at the university stage in Egypt with the first Kuwaiti batch to Cairo in 1956, and what they were subjected to during their journey. / يتناول المسلسل قصص مجموعة من الطالبات الكويتيات، أثناء فترة دراستهن بالمرحلة الجامعية في مصر مع أول دفعة كويتية إلى القاهرة العام 1956، وما تعرضن له خلال رحلتهن.

programme.title: Raisinghani vs raisinghani / Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, the skilled smart lawyer (Anushka) works with her ambitious colleague (Firat), but their lives change after the appearance of the trainee (Ankita) who hides her true intention and hides under the guise of the researcher for a job opportunity. / في إطار درامي، تعمل المحامية الذكية الماهرة (أنوشكا) مع زميلها الطموح (فيرات)، ولكن تتغير حياتهما بعد ظهور المتدربة (أنكيتا) التي تخفي نيتها الحقيقية وتتخفى تحت ستار الباحثة عن فرصة عمل.

programme.title: Oh God, I am fasting / اللهم إني صايم
programme.desc: The story of the series “Oh God, I am fasting” revolves around “Ali Abu Al Karamat” (Mustafa Shaban). “Ali” lived throughout his life spoiled by his mother and is not punished for his mistakes, so he grew up to become an unpleasant person, always lies and never says the truth and everyone around him knows his lie. "Ali" begins to exploit his talent in that lies in order to make money, and he will set up some of the big businessmen. "Ali" believes that the people of the people must be taken from their money to the poor, but businessmen begin to reveal his monument, and it is chased by businessmen in addition to the police. What will happen in that chase? Is Ali arrested or found businessmen to take revenge on him, or can he escape? / تدور احداث قصة مسلسل “اللهم إني صائم” حول “على ابو الكرامات” (مصطفى شعبان) , عاش “علي” طوال حياته مدلل من والدته و لا يتم عقابه على اخطائه , فكبر ليصبح انسان غير سوي , دائمًا ما يكذب و لا يقول الحقيقة ابدًا و كل من حوله يعرفون كذبه . يبدأ “علي” استغلال موهبته في الكذب تلك من اجل جني المال , فيقوم بالنصب على بعض رجال الاعمال الكبار . يؤمن “علي” بان اولائك الاشخاص يجب ان يؤخذ من مالهم للفقراء , و لكن يبدأ رجال الاعمال في كشف نصبه, و يطارده رجال الاعمال اولائك بالاضافة الى الشرطة . ماذا سيحدث في تلك المطاردة ؟. هل يتم القبض على “علي” او يعثر عليه رجال الاعمال لينتقموا منه ام يستطيع الهروب ؟.

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic framework, the rich and reckless businessman (Ashraf) is in love with (Revelation), who was looking for a person like his life, but what is ignorant of him is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

programme.title: Dirty Laundry / Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: In a comic dramatic framework, the series deals with the lives of the richest and most powerful families in Istanbul, and their maids who are subjected to secrets, puzzles and crimes hidden behind the doors of these closed houses, and they often become parts of them. / في إطار درامي كوميدي، يتناول المسلسل حياة أغنى وأقوى العائلات في إسطنبول، وخادماتهم اللاتي يتعرضن للأسرار والألغاز والجرائم المخبأة خلف أبواب هذه المنازل المغلقة، وغالبًا ما يصبحن أجزاء منها.

programme.title: Golden Boy / Golden Boy
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where (Hallis Agha), one of the pillars of the established families in the city of (Gaziantep), decides to marry his riotous grandson (Farid), then the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقرر (هاليس آغا)، وهو أحد أعمدة العائلات الراسخة في مدينة (غازي عنتاب)، تزويج حفيده المشاغب (فريد)، ثم تتوالى الأحداث.

programme.desc: Eight women of forty -four years of age are engaged in many life challenges together, at the family, emotional and professional levels, and each of them seeks to enhance stability in her life at all levels, and achieve her aspirations before it is too late. / تخوض ثماني نساء في الرابعة والأربعين من العمر العديد من التحديات الحياتية معًا، على المستوى الأسري والعاطفي والمهني، وتسعى كل واحدة منهن لتعزيز الاستقرار في حياتها على كافة الأصعدة، وتحقيق طموحاتها قبل فوات الأوان.

programme.title: Esref Ruya / Esref Ruya
programme.desc: In a romantic framework, the rich and reckless businessman (Ashraf) is in love with (Revelation), who was looking for a person like his life, but what is ignorant of him is that she is working against him for the police. / في إطار رومانسي، يقع رجل الأعمال الثري والمتهور (أشرف) في حب (رؤيا) التي كان يبحث عن شخصية مثلها طوال حياته، لكن ما يجهله هو أنها تعمل ضده لدى الشرطة.

programme.title: Dirty Laundry / Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: In a comic dramatic framework, the series deals with the lives of the richest and most powerful families in Istanbul, and their maids who are subjected to secrets, puzzles and crimes hidden behind the doors of these closed houses, and they often become parts of them. / في إطار درامي كوميدي، يتناول المسلسل حياة أغنى وأقوى العائلات في إسطنبول، وخادماتهم اللاتي يتعرضن للأسرار والألغاز والجرائم المخبأة خلف أبواب هذه المنازل المغلقة، وغالبًا ما يصبحن أجزاء منها.

programme.title: Cairo batch / دفعة القاهرة
programme.desc: The series deals with the stories of a group of Kuwaiti female students, during their studies at the university stage in Egypt with the first Kuwaiti batch to Cairo in 1956, and what they were subjected to during their journey. / يتناول المسلسل قصص مجموعة من الطالبات الكويتيات، أثناء فترة دراستهن بالمرحلة الجامعية في مصر مع أول دفعة كويتية إلى القاهرة العام 1956، وما تعرضن له خلال رحلتهن.

programme.title: Raisinghani vs raisinghani / Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
programme.desc: In a dramatic framework, the skilled smart lawyer (Anushka) works with her ambitious colleague (Firat), but their lives change after the appearance of the trainee (Ankita) who hides her true intention and hides under the guise of the researcher for a job opportunity. / في إطار درامي، تعمل المحامية الذكية الماهرة (أنوشكا) مع زميلها الطموح (فيرات)، ولكن تتغير حياتهما بعد ظهور المتدربة (أنكيتا) التي تخفي نيتها الحقيقية وتتخفى تحت ستار الباحثة عن فرصة عمل.

programme.title: Oh God, I am fasting / اللهم إني صايم
programme.desc: The story of the series “Oh God, I am fasting” revolves around “Ali Abu Al Karamat” (Mustafa Shaban). “Ali” lived throughout his life spoiled by his mother and is not punished for his mistakes, so he grew up to become an unpleasant person, always lies and never says the truth and everyone around him knows his lie. "Ali" begins to exploit his talent in that lies in order to make money, and he will set up some of the big businessmen. "Ali" believes that the people of the people must be taken from their money to the poor, but businessmen begin to reveal his monument, and it is chased by businessmen in addition to the police. What will happen in that chase? Is Ali arrested or found businessmen to take revenge on him, or can he escape? / تدور احداث قصة مسلسل “اللهم إني صائم” حول “على ابو الكرامات” (مصطفى شعبان) , عاش “علي” طوال حياته مدلل من والدته و لا يتم عقابه على اخطائه , فكبر ليصبح انسان غير سوي , دائمًا ما يكذب و لا يقول الحقيقة ابدًا و كل من حوله يعرفون كذبه . يبدأ “علي” استغلال موهبته في الكذب تلك من اجل جني المال , فيقوم بالنصب على بعض رجال الاعمال الكبار . يؤمن “علي” بان اولائك الاشخاص يجب ان يؤخذ من مالهم للفقراء , و لكن يبدأ رجال الاعمال في كشف نصبه, و يطارده رجال الاعمال اولائك بالاضافة الى الشرطة . ماذا سيحدث في تلك المطاردة ؟. هل يتم القبض على “علي” او يعثر عليه رجال الاعمال لينتقموا منه ام يستطيع الهروب ؟.

programme.title: Love game / لعبة حب
programme.desc: A wealthy young man is in love with a poor girl, then he later discovers that his relative and grandfather are the ones who pushed the money to the girl to take advantage of her need, in order to sign him in her net and marry her, and the events follow. / يقع شاب ثري في حب فتاة فقيرة، ثم يكتشف لاحقًا أن قريبته وجده هما من دفعا المال إلى الفتاة استغلالًا لاحتياجها، لكي توقعه في شباكها ويتزوجها، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: Golden Boy / Golden Boy
programme.desc: The events take place in a dramatic framework, where (Hallis Agha), one of the pillars of the established families in the city of (Gaziantep), decides to marry his riotous grandson (Farid), then the events continue. / تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، حيث يقرر (هاليس آغا)، وهو أحد أعمدة العائلات الراسخة في مدينة (غازي عنتاب)، تزويج حفيده المشاغب (فريد)، ثم تتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: disappearance / اختفاء
programme.desc: The events revolve around a university doctor in Russia, and she lives with her husband there, but suddenly and without introductions her husband disappears, to start the journey of searching for him, and it comes to returning to Egypt as part of her research journey, but this trip surprises her with many things that she was not aware of. / تدور الأحداث حول دكتورة جامعية في روسيا، وتعيش مع زوجها هناك، لكن فجأة وبدون مقدمات يختفي زوجها، لتبدأ رحلة البحث عنه، ويصل بها الأمر للعودة إلى مصر في إطار رحلة بحثها، لكن هذه الرحلة تفاجئها بالكثير من الأمور التي لم تكن على علم بها.

programme.title: Your morning is Egyptian / صباحك مصري
programme.desc: A daily program, concerned with everything that happens in Egypt daily, by displaying all types of news, political, economic, as well as social, technical, and trying to highlight and present positive models in society, and hosting a group of decision makers in (Egypt) to discuss problems, community negatives, and how to solve them. / برنامج يومي، يهتم بكل ما يحدث في مصر يومياً، من خلال عرض جميع أنواع الأخبار سياسية، واقتصادية، وكذلك اجتماعية، وفنية، ومحاولة إبراز وعرض النماذج اﻹيجابية في المجتمع، واستضافة نخبة من صناع القرار في (مصر) لمناقشة المشكلات، وسلبيات المجتمع، وكيفية حلها.

programme.title: From the heart to the heart / من القلب للقلب
programme.desc: A social program, talking about topics related to charitable works and opening a door for viewers ’participation through social media. / برنامج اجتماعي، يتحدث عن موضوعات متعلقة بالأعمال الخيرية وفتح باب لمشاركة المشاهدين من خلال مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي.

programme.title: For a cat / لمعي القط
programme.desc: The series revolves around a bus driver (Mohamed Imam) in a private school, and while the driver returns the students to their homes after the end of the school day, one of the parents kidnaps the school bus and requests a great ransom. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول سائق أتوبيس (محمد إمام) فى أحد المدارس الخاصة، وأثناء إعادة السائق التلاميذ لمنازلهم بعد إنتهاء اليوم الدراسي، يختطف أحد أولياء الأمور أتوبيس المدرسة ويطلب فدية كبيرة.

programme.title: Vanshaj / Vanshaj
programme.desc: The series revolves around (Juvena), the girl who differs with her family about the issue of inheriting the family's business for male members and demands inheritance for the most worthy. / تدور احداث المسلسل حول (يوفيكا) الفتاة التي تختلف مع عائلتها حول مسألة وراثة أعمال العائلة للأعضاء الذكور وتطالب بالوراثة للأجدر.

programme.title: Price / الثمن
programme.desc: The widow Sarah resorted to her only remaining option to cover the costs of treating her son Ibrahim from cancer, so he agreed to spend one night with the company manager Zain for an amount of money. / تلجأ الأرملة سارة لخيارها الوحيد المتبقي لتغطية تكاليف علاج ابنها إبراهيم من السرطان، فتوافق على قضاء ليلة واحدة مع مدير الشركة زين مقابل مبلغ من المال.

programme.title: Omar Law / قانون عمر
programme.desc: The events revolve around a mechanical engineer called (Omar) who works in a car maintenance center, and he is in love with (Iman Al -Assi), daughter of the maintenance center, then an accident that turns his life upside down, and he is thrown behind the iron bars; However, he can escape, and begins to prove his innocence. / تدور الأحداث حول مهندس ميكانيكي يٌدعى (عمر) يعمل في مركز صيانة سيارات، ويقع في حب (إيمان العاصي) ابنة صاحب مركز الصيانة، ثم يقع له حادث يقلب حياته رأسًا على عقب، ويزج به خلف القضبان الحديدية؛ إلا أنه يتمكن من الهرب، ويبدأ في إثبات برائته.

programme.title: Under the seventh land / تحت سابع أرض

programme.title: Habib met / وتقابل حبيب
programme.desc: A wealthy woman discovers her husband's betrayal of her and marrying her, so she decides to separate from him and searches for a new love relationship, but she is involved in various conflicts that she did not expect, and her life changes with her gradually. / تكتشف امرأة ثرية خيانة زوجها لها والزواج عليها، فتقرر الانفصال عنه وتبحث عن علاقة حب جديدة، لكنها تتورط في صراعات مختلفة لم تكن تتوقعها، وتتغير معها حياتها تدريجيًا.

programme.title: Selma / سلمى
programme.desc: The series deals with the story of Salma, a young mother who faces life alone after her husband, Jalal, disappeared in mysterious circumstances. programme.desc: After the channel’s bankruptcy, the employees are surprised by the purchase of a businessman, and he is called the only channel, and he managed it with his secretary, flames, so jealousy and competition arises between everyone to prove every person. / بعد إفلاس القناة، يفاجئ الموظفين بشراء أحد رجال الأعمال، ويُدعى وحيد للقناة، ويتولى إدارتها برفقة سكرتيرته لهيب، فتنشأ الغيرة والمنافسة بين الجميع لإثبات كل شخص مكانه.

programme.title: Our club program / برنامج نادينا
Berlk's journey / سفر برلك
programme.desc: The work deals with the period of the issuance of the mandatory military service issued by the Ottoman Sultan at the time for all who are at the age of service and in the entire areas that fall under the control of the Ottomans at the time, through the story of four young men who gathered one idea towards independence. / يتناول العمل فترة صدور فرمان الخدمة العسكرية الإلزامية التي أصدرها السلطان العثماني آنذاك لكل من هم في عمر الخدمة وفي كامل المناطق التي تقع تحت سيطرة العثمانيين آنذاك، وذلك من خلال قصة أربعة شبان تجمعهم فكرة واحدة نحو الاستقلال.

programme.title: Mira and Salim / ميرا وسليم
programme.desc: Divorce threatens Mira and Salim's life, but the discovery of Salim's illness is his wife's illness drives him to re -ignite the love relationship between them. With the return of the love of the past and its secrets, their fragile relationship is tested between love and loyalty and a second opportunity for life together. / يهدد الطلاق حياة ميرا وسليم، لكن اكتشاف سليم مرض زوجته يدفعه للعمل على إعادة إشعال علاقة الحب بينهما. ومع عودة حب الماضي وأسراره، تُختبر علاقتهما الهشة بين الحب والوفاء وفرصة ثانية للحياة معًا.

programme.title: The Office / The Office
programme.desc: The series revolves around (Hannah Howard), the managing director of a company, where she finds herself in trouble after knowing the news of closing her branch and converting it to work remotely, so she is trying hard to keep her team together. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول (هانا هوارد) العضو المنتدب لأحد الشركات، حيث تجد نفسها في ورطة بعد معرفتها بخبر إغلاق الفرع الخاص بها وتحويله للعمل عن بعد، لذا تحاول جاهدة الحفاظ على فريق العمل الخاص بها معاً.

programme.title: Under the seventh land / تحت سابع أرض
programme.desc: The officer (Moussa) takes advantage of his powers to achieve personal gains in corrupt and twisted ways, which makes him in a direct confrontation with the people who blackmail them, while discovering that his two brothers visit the dollars, and he finds himself in a difficult dilemma between leaving them to face the gangs alone, or managing this work himself to protect them. / يستغل الضابط (موسى) صلاحياته لتحقيق مكاسب شخصية بطرق فاسدة وملتوية، مما يجعله في مواجهة مباشرة مع الأشخاص الذين يبتزهم، بينما يكتشف أن أخويه يزوران الدولارات، فيجد نفسه في مأزق صعب بين تركهم لمواجهة العصابات بمفردهما، أو إدارة هذا العمل بنفسه لحمايتهما.

programme.title: Habib met / وتقابل حبيب

programme.title: Selma / سلمى

We follow his story in Egypt and the arrangement of Egyptian intelligence for his Jewish history in it and how he left Egypt to start the journey of spy against Israel in favor of Egyptian intelligence. / الجزء الأول من الملحمة الوطنية المستوحاة من قصة الجاسوس المصري (رفعت علي سليمان الجمال) الذي تم زرعه داخل المجتمع اﻹسرائيلي للتجسس لصالح المخابرات المصرية. يقوم (محمود عبد العزيز) بدرو رفعت الجمال أو رأفت الهجان. نتعرف في الجزء الأول على مقدمة الملحمة وعلاقة رأفت بالمخابرات المصرية، ونتعرف على زوجته هيلين سمحون (يسرا). نتابع قصته في مصر وترتيب المخابرات المصرية لتاريخه اليهودي فيها وكيفية خروجه من مصر ليبدأ رحلة الجاسوسية ضد إسرائيل لصالح المخابرات المصرية.

programme.desc: One of the most important talk shows began to broadcast in 2006 with Moataz Al -Demerdash and Reham Al -Sahli, but in 2011 the journalist Amr Al -Laithi joined the program after Al -Demerdash withdrew from his presentation. The program is concerned with important news and daily events that revolve in the Egyptian and Arab street, as well as monitor the interests, opinions and aspirations of viewers, as well as many guests from politicians, media and economics. / أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد.

Shame / العار
programme.desc: The events of the series revolve around the family of Hajj Abdel Sattar, who trades in drugs and helps his older son without knowing his family, and when Abdel -Sattar dies, his sons know the truth of the matter from their older brother, so they decide to complete the agreed drug deal, and so that their money is not lost. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول أسرة الحاج عبد الستار الذي يتاجر في المخدرات ويعاونه ابنه الأكبر دون أن تدري عائلته، وعندما يتوفى عبدالستار يعلم ابناؤه بحقيقة الأمر من شقيقهم الأكبر، فيقرروا إتمام صفقة المخدرات المتفق عليها، وحتى لا تضيع أموالهم، .

programme.title: program / برنامج
program / برنامج
Abdulaziz Street / شارع عبدالعزيز
programme.desc: Abdel Aziz goes through many fluctuations that any young man goes through at the beginning of his life, through his joining one of the Islamic groups, then he leaves it to join the left political current and works in the end on Abdel Aziz Street, then he is able to achieve wealth, as he becomes one of the largest merchants of the shop there. / يمر عبد العزيز بالعديد من التقلبات التي يمر بها أي شاب في بداية حياته مرورًا بانضمامه إلى إحدى الجماعات اﻹسلامية ثم يتركها لينضم إلى التيار السياسي اليساري ويعمل في النهاية بشارع عبد العزيز ثم يتمكن من تحقيق الثراء حيث يصبح أحد اكبر تجار المحال هناك.

programme.title: Dalaa girls / دلع بنات
programme.desc: The series revolves around a comic framework about class differences in society through the story of two friends, one of which belongs to the popular class, while the other belongs to the bourgeois class, and this difference between them generates many paradoxes and comic situations. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار كوميدي حول الفوارق الطبقية في المجتمع من خلال قصة صديقتين، تنتمي إحداهما للطبقة الشعبية، بينما تنتمى الأخرى للطبقة البرجوازية، ويولد هذا الاختلاف بينهما العديد من المفارقات والمواقف الكوميدية.

programme.title: Faces / وجوه
programme.desc: The series of faces is divided into two stories: What are you, and Mitafs. The story of a doctor who graduated from the prison was presented to start a journey of searching for her daughter and the journey of facing psychosis. In Metaver, the heroine rejects life in reality and storms the virtual world to take revenge on its enemies. / ينقسم مسلسل وجوه إلى قصتين: وش تالت، وميتافرس. تقدم وش تالت قصة طبيبة تخرج من السجن لتبدأ رحلة بحث عن ابنتها ورحلة مواجهة مرض الذهان. أما في ميتافرس، ترفض البطلة الحياة في الواقع وتقتحم العالم الافتراضي لتنتقم لنفسها من أعدائها.

programme.title: With 100 men / بـ١٠٠ راجل
programme.desc: In a social dramatic framework, the events revolve around (Ghalia Abu Al -Dahab) that faces many troubles, and after the killing of her husband (Adel) during their wedding ceremony, (Ghalia) is forced to work as a microbus driver; And face many shocks, the most important of which is her imprisonment. / في إطار درامي اجتماعي، تدور الأحداث حول (غالية أبو الدهب) التي تواجه العديد من المتاعب، وبعد مقتل زوجها (عادل) خلال حفل زفافهما، تضطر (غالية) للعمل سائقة ميكروباص؛ وتواجه العديد من الصدمات أهمها دخولها السجن.

programme.title: Arabi / العربجي
programme.desc: A dramatic epic that ignites fire from the womb of injustice and darkness, where the story of Abdo Al -Arabji, which works to transport goods on Tanbar; To support his family. However, Abu Hamza's injustice to him enter into conflicts with him and his son Hamza. Between hatred of a role, and the revenge of Drie Khanm - the wife of Abu Hamza's brother - how will Abdo face the intrigues? Will it remain for love from a place in the shadow of all these wars? / ملحمة درامية تُشعل النار من رحم الظلم والظلام، وذلك حيث قصة عبده العربجي، الذي يعمل على نقل البضائع على الطنبر؛ لإعالة عائلته. لكنّ ظلم أبو حمزة النشواتي له يُدخله في صراعات معه ومع ابنه حمزة. وبين حقد بدور، وانتقام دريّة خانم - زوجة شقيق أبو حمزة- كيف سيُواجه عبده المكائد؟ وهل سيبقى للحبّ من مكان في ظلّ كلّ هذه الحروب؟
