Digger / الحفار
programme.desc: After the occupation of the Sinai Peninsula by the Israeli forces in 1967 and the outbreak of the war of attrition, Israel announced that it had carried out extensive operations to excavate oil in the Sinai and rent a digger to carry out this task, and this matter has only one purpose, which is to show the Egyptian authorities with the appearance of a little trick in front of what Israel is doing, which prompted the Egyptian intelligence to plan to deal with the digger before reaching the door. / بعد احتلال شبه جزيرة سيناء من قبل القوات الإسرائيلية في عام 1967 واندلاع حرب الاستنزاف، أعلنت إسرائيل عن قيامها بعمليات موسعة للتنقيب عن البترول في سيناء وتأجير حفار للقيام بهذه المهمة، وهذا الأمر ليس له سوى غرض واحد، وهو إظهار السلطات المصرية بمظهر العاجز قليل الحيلة أمام ما تقوم به إسرائيل، وهو ما دفع المخابرات المصرية للتخطيط من أجل التعامل مع الحفار قبل وصوله إلى باب المندب.

programme.title: A rich man .. very poor / رجل غني .. فقير جدًا
programme.desc: The events revolve around a man who becomes a billionaire, and he believes that he owned the world, including, and then discovers that he is very poor because he lacks peace of mind and reassurance, and this is due to reasons, including the continuous American threats of the life of the big Arab family. / تدور الأحداث حول رجل يصبح مليارديرًا، فيعتقد أنه امتلك العالم بما فيه، ثم يكتشف أنه فقير جدًا لأنه يفتقد راحة البال والطمأنينة، ويعود هذا الى أسباب منها التهديدات الأميركية المستمرة لحياة الأسرة العربية الكبيرة.

programme.title: flash / فلاش
programme.desc: An artistic program, which offers the latest news of artists and what relates to their works in cinema, theater and television drama. There is also a paragraph for phone interventions with the stars to make statements or discuss an artistic issue. / برنامج فني، يقدم آخر أخبار الفنانين وما يتعلق بأعمالهم في السينما والمسرح والدراما التليفزيونية، كما توجد فقرة للمداخلات الهاتفية مع النجوم للإدلاء بتصريحات أو مناقشة قضية فنية.

programme.title: Deviation / انحراف
programme.desc: The series is taken from real events, which revolve in a teaser drama full of mystery, about the deviation of a number of personalities from human nature; They collide with a psychiatrist and decide to adjust the path in its own way. / المسلسل مأخوذ عن أحداث حقيقية، تدور فى دراما تشويقية مليئة بالغموض، حول انحراف عدد من الشخصيات عن الطبيعة البشرية؛ يصطدمون بطبيبة نفسية وتقرر تعديل المسار بطريقتها الخاصة.

programme.title: Word of men / كلام رجالة
programme.desc: The series deals with five stories of five women, including the working woman, the woman of society, the important wife of the man, and the corrupt lawyer, but what they collected is that they have replaced their husbands in managing home and family affairs, to decide to gather every Tuesday a week, discuss the problems of each of them, and try to solve them. / يتناول المسلسل خمس قصص لخمس نساء، منهن المرأة العاملة، وسيدة المجتمع، وزوجة الرجل المهم، وحرم المحامي الفاسد، ولكن ما جمعهن هو أنهن حللن محل أزواجهن في إدارة شئون البيت والأسرة، ليقررن التجمع كل يوم ثلاثاء في الأسبوع، ومناقشة مشاكل كل واحدة منهن، ومحاولة حلها.

programme.title: In the blink of an eye / في غمضة عين
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around (Fatima) and (Nabila), two friends, who were raised together with one of the orphans, until they worked two supervisors in the same shelter, suffering from the cruelty of life in the shelter, until Nabila discovers that she has a wealthy uncle and she goes to see him, and on the way an accident occurs and her friend believes that she died, and events escalate. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول (فاطمة) و(نبيلة) وهما صديقتان، تربيتا معاَ بأحد ملاجيء الأيتام، حتى عملتا مشرفتين في الملجأ نفسه، تعانيان من قسوة الحياة في الملجأ، حتى تكتشف نبيلة أن لها عم ثري فتذهب لرؤيته، وفي الطريق تقع حادثة وتعتقد صديقتها أنها ماتت، وتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: flash / فلاش
programme.desc: An artistic program, which offers the latest news of artists and what relates to their works in cinema, theater and television drama. There is also a paragraph for phone interventions with the stars to make statements or discuss an artistic issue. / برنامج فني، يقدم آخر أخبار الفنانين وما يتعلق بأعمالهم في السينما والمسرح والدراما التليفزيونية، كما توجد فقرة للمداخلات الهاتفية مع النجوم للإدلاء بتصريحات أو مناقشة قضية فنية.

programme.title: Asmahan / أسمهان
programme.desc: The work deals with the life story of the late singer Asmahan, from her birth until her transfer from Beirut to Cairo to work as a singer and actress, to shine her name next to her brother Farid Al -Atrash, and the series touches on her relationship with some of the artists who lived with her until her mysterious death. / يتناول العمل قصة حياة المطربة الراحلة أسمهان، منذ ميلادها حتى إنتقالها من بيروت إلى القاهرة للعمل كمطربة وممثلة، ليلمع اسمها بجوار شقيقها فريد الأطرش، ويتطرق المسلسل إلى علاقتها ببعض الفنانين الذين عاصروها وحتى حادث وفاتها الغامض.

programme.title: Delivery groom / عريس دليفري
programme.desc: A simple young man dies his parents without leaving any inheritance for him, and his condition is bad and admires the girl of the daughter of an employee with his father. At the same time, he gets to know the daughter of a businesswoman who owns a hotel in which that young man works, so the mother tries to do what he can to remove her daughter. / شاب بسيط يتوفى والديه دون أن يتركا له اي ميراث فتسوء حالته ويعجب بفتاة ابنة احد الموظفين لدى والده وف الوقت ذاته يتعرف على ابنة سيدة أعمال تمتلك فندقًا يعمل فيه ذلك الشاب فتحاول اﻷم بذل ما في وسعها ﻹبعاده عن ابنتها.

programme.title: Disobedience c 1 / العصيان ج1
programme.desc: Social drama, which discusses the human relations interfering between members of the same family, especially if they are exposed to the temptation of money and does it spoil the souls of human beings to the degree that makes the son covet the money of his father and asks for stone on him under pressure and his wife is urgent. / دراما إجتماعية، تناقش العلاقات الإنسانية المتداخلة بين أفراد الأسرة الواحدة وخاصة إذا ما تعرضوا لإغراء المال وهل يفسد نفوس البشر للدرجة التى تجعل الإبن يطمع فى مال أبيه ويطلب الحجر عليه تحت ضغط والحاح زوجته.

programme.title: flash / فلاش
programme.desc: An artistic program, which offers the latest news of artists and what relates to their works in cinema, theater and television drama. programme.title: Digger / الحفار
programme.desc: After the occupation of the Sinai Peninsula by the Israeli forces in 1967 and the outbreak of the war of attrition, Israel announced that it had carried out extensive operations to excavate oil in the Sinai and rent a digger to carry out this task, and this matter has only one purpose, which is to show the Egyptian authorities with the appearance of a little trick in front of what Israel is doing, which prompted the Egyptian intelligence to plan to deal with the digger before reaching the door. / بعد احتلال شبه جزيرة سيناء من قبل القوات الإسرائيلية في عام 1967 واندلاع حرب الاستنزاف، أعلنت إسرائيل عن قيامها بعمليات موسعة للتنقيب عن البترول في سيناء وتأجير حفار للقيام بهذه المهمة، وهذا الأمر ليس له سوى غرض واحد، وهو إظهار السلطات المصرية بمظهر العاجز قليل الحيلة أمام ما تقوم به إسرائيل، وهو ما دفع المخابرات المصرية للتخطيط من أجل التعامل مع الحفار قبل وصوله إلى باب المندب.

programme.title: A rich man .. very poor / رجل غني .. فقير جدًا
programme.desc: The events revolve around a man who becomes a billionaire, and he believes that he owned the world, including, and then discovers that he is very poor because he lacks peace of mind and reassurance, and this is due to reasons, including the continuous American threats of the life of the big Arab family. / تدور الأحداث حول رجل يصبح مليارديرًا، فيعتقد أنه امتلك العالم بما فيه، ثم يكتشف أنه فقير جدًا لأنه يفتقد راحة البال والطمأنينة، ويعود هذا الى أسباب منها التهديدات الأميركية المستمرة لحياة الأسرة العربية الكبيرة.

programme.title: Deviation / انحراف
programme.desc: The series is taken from real events, which revolve in a teaser drama full of mystery, about the deviation of a number of personalities from human nature; They collide with a psychiatrist and decide to adjust the path in its own way. / المسلسل مأخوذ عن أحداث حقيقية، تدور فى دراما تشويقية مليئة بالغموض، حول انحراف عدد من الشخصيات عن الطبيعة البشرية؛ يصطدمون بطبيبة نفسية وتقرر تعديل المسار بطريقتها الخاصة.

programme.title: flash / فلاش
programme.desc: An artistic program, which offers the latest news of artists and what relates to their works in cinema, theater and television drama. programme.title: Word of men / كلام رجالة
programme.desc: The series deals with five stories of five women, including the working woman, the woman of society, the important wife of the man, and the corrupt lawyer, but what they collected is that they have replaced their husbands in managing home and family affairs, to decide to gather every Tuesday a week, discuss the problems of each of them, and try to solve them. / يتناول المسلسل خمس قصص لخمس نساء، منهن المرأة العاملة، وسيدة المجتمع، وزوجة الرجل المهم، وحرم المحامي الفاسد، ولكن ما جمعهن هو أنهن حللن محل أزواجهن في إدارة شئون البيت والأسرة، ليقررن التجمع كل يوم ثلاثاء في الأسبوع، ومناقشة مشاكل كل واحدة منهن، ومحاولة حلها.

programme.title: In the blink of an eye / في غمضة عين
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around (Fatima) and (Nabila), two friends, who were raised together with one of the orphans, until they worked two supervisors in the same shelter, suffering from the cruelty of life in the shelter, until Nabila discovers that she has a wealthy uncle and she goes to see him, and on the way an accident occurs and her friend believes that she died, and events escalate. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول (فاطمة) و(نبيلة) وهما صديقتان، تربيتا معاَ بأحد ملاجيء الأيتام، حتى عملتا مشرفتين في الملجأ نفسه، تعانيان من قسوة الحياة في الملجأ، حتى تكتشف نبيلة أن لها عم ثري فتذهب لرؤيته، وفي الطريق تقع حادثة وتعتقد صديقتها أنها ماتت، وتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: Asmahan / أسمهان
programme.desc: The work deals with the life story of the late singer Asmahan, from her birth until her transfer from Beirut to Cairo to work as a singer and actress, to shine her name next to her brother Farid Al -Atrash, and the series touches on her relationship with some of the artists who lived with her until her mysterious death. / يتناول العمل قصة حياة المطربة الراحلة أسمهان، منذ ميلادها حتى إنتقالها من بيروت إلى القاهرة للعمل كمطربة وممثلة، ليلمع اسمها بجوار شقيقها فريد الأطرش، ويتطرق المسلسل إلى علاقتها ببعض الفنانين الذين عاصروها وحتى حادث وفاتها الغامض.

programme.title: Delivery groom / عريس دليفري
programme.desc: A simple young man dies his parents without leaving any inheritance for him, and his condition is bad and admires the girl of the daughter of an employee with his father. At the same time, he gets to know the daughter of a businesswoman who owns a hotel in which that young man works, so the mother tries to do what he can to remove her daughter. / شاب بسيط يتوفى والديه دون أن يتركا له اي ميراث فتسوء حالته ويعجب بفتاة ابنة احد الموظفين لدى والده وف الوقت ذاته يتعرف على ابنة سيدة أعمال تمتلك فندقًا يعمل فيه ذلك الشاب فتحاول اﻷم بذل ما في وسعها ﻹبعاده عن ابنتها.

programme.desc: Social drama, which discusses the human relations interfering between members of the same family, especially if they are exposed to the temptation of money and does it spoil the souls of human beings to the degree that makes the son covet the money of his father and asks for stone on him under pressure and his wife is urgent. / دراما إجتماعية، تناقش العلاقات الإنسانية المتداخلة بين أفراد الأسرة الواحدة وخاصة إذا ما تعرضوا لإغراء المال وهل يفسد نفوس البشر للدرجة التى تجعل الإبن يطمع فى مال أبيه ويطلب الحجر عليه تحت ضغط والحاح زوجته.

programme.title: Digger / الحفار
programme.desc: After the occupation of the Sinai Peninsula by the Israeli forces in 1967 and the outbreak of the war of attrition, Israel announced that it had carried out extensive operations to excavate oil in the Sinai and rent a digger to carry out this task, and this matter has only one purpose, which is to show the Egyptian authorities with the appearance of a little trick in front of what Israel is doing, which prompted the Egyptian intelligence to plan to deal with the digger before reaching the door. / بعد احتلال شبه جزيرة سيناء من قبل القوات الإسرائيلية في عام 1967 واندلاع حرب الاستنزاف، أعلنت إسرائيل عن قيامها بعمليات موسعة للتنقيب عن البترول في سيناء وتأجير حفار للقيام بهذه المهمة، وهذا الأمر ليس له سوى غرض واحد، وهو إظهار السلطات المصرية بمظهر العاجز قليل الحيلة أمام ما تقوم به إسرائيل، وهو ما دفع المخابرات المصرية للتخطيط من أجل التعامل مع الحفار قبل وصوله إلى باب المندب.

programme.title: A rich man .. very poor / رجل غني .. فقير جدًا
programme.desc: The events revolve around a man who becomes a billionaire, and he believes that he owned the world, including, and then discovers that he is very poor because he lacks peace of mind and reassurance, and this is due to reasons, including the continuous American threats of the life of the big Arab family. / تدور الأحداث حول رجل يصبح مليارديرًا، فيعتقد أنه امتلك العالم بما فيه، ثم يكتشف أنه فقير جدًا لأنه يفتقد راحة البال والطمأنينة، ويعود هذا الى أسباب منها التهديدات الأميركية المستمرة لحياة الأسرة العربية الكبيرة.

programme.title: Hunter / الصياد
programme.desc: The series revolves around a young man working in a security agency, and after an accident that hinders him from practicing his work tasks, he is excluded from work in the device, but at a later time the security apparatus is confused in front of one of the cases, and they have no choice but to use again the same young man who dispensed with him in the past to help them reveal mystery about this issue. / تدور أحداث المسلسل حول شاب يعمل في أحد الأجهزة الأمنية، وبعد أن يقع له حادث يعيقه عن ممارسة مهام عمله، يتم استبعاده عن العمل في الجهاز، ولكن في وقت لاحق يقع أفراد الجهاز الأمني في حيرة أمام إحدى القضايا، ولا يبقى أمامهم سوى الاستعانة مجددًا بنفس الشاب الذي استغنوا عنه في السابق ليساعدهم في كشف الغموض حول هذه القضية.

programme.desc: A beautiful young woman (Yousra Al -Lawzi) in her uncle's house among his wife and daughter, and despite the loss of her parents and her upbringing in the house of a hateful, arrogant man possessing greed and love of money and influence, she learned patience and formed with love and tenderness. programme.title: Customer 1001 / العميل ١٠٠١
programme.desc: The series revolves around one of the Egyptian intelligence files about the Egyptian youth Amr Tolba, an Egyptian spy, who was able to penetrate into the Israeli army and society in a successful operation before the 1973 war, discovers the great similarity between Amr and Moses, the Jewish young man who died in the Egyptian city of Tanta, so the similarity to the recruitment of Amr as a spy in Israel is exploited. / تدور أحداث المسلسل من إحدى ملفات المخابرات المصرية حول الشاب المصري عمرو طلبة جاسوس مصري استطاع أن يتغلغل إلى الجيش والمجتمع الإسرائيلي في عملية ناجحة قبل حرب 1973م، يُكتشف الشبه الكبير بين عمرو وموسى، الشاب اليهودي الذي مات في مدينة طنطا المصرية، فيتم استغلال الشبه لتجنيد عمرو كجاسوس في إسرائيل.

programme.title: LaLiga / LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera Division) is the mens top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.title: Basketball / Basketball
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend. / The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. programme.desc: If you open the Czech language dictionary of 1971, you will find that "color" is "one of the basic characteristics of matter, perceived by vision caused by the ability to absorb light beams on various wave lengths" or that it is a "staining substance" or that "all cards with the same label" Generally speaking - that dictionary indicates that the word "color" can have a total of nine meanings in the literary Czech. How many others have been attributed to him non -literary, he does not mention it. Therefore, it can be assumed that in the next edition a regular TV show Show Banánove Rybičky can be said virtually anything. Jana Krausová and Stanislav Zindulka will be guests of Halina Pawlowske. / Otevřete-li si Slovník spisovneho jazyka českeho z roku 1971, zjistíte, že "barva" je "jedna ze základních vlastností hmoty, vnímaná zrakem, způsobená schopností hmoty pohlcovat světelne paprsky o různých vlnových delkách" nebo, že to je "barvící látka" nebo, že tak lze označit "všechny karty se stejným označením" či dokonce "krev lovne zvěře či loveckých psů". Obecně řečeno – onen slovník udává, že slovo "barva" může mít ve spisovne češtině celkem devět významů. Kolik dalších mu jich přisoudila čeština nespisovná, o to se raději nezmiňuje. Proto lze předpokládat, že v dalším vydání pravidelne televizní talk show Banánove rybičky může být řeč prakticky o čemkoli. Hosty Haliny Pawlowske tentokrát budou Jana Krausová a Stanislav Zindulka.

programme.title: The stories of the famous / Příběhy slavných
programme.desc: In the cycle of the famous stories today you have the opportunity to look at the documentary of director Vladimír Chrenovský one of the most famous personalities of Czechoslovak and Czech hockey - Ivan Hlinka. He joined the first league of the match as a youth at the age of sixteen, and among adults he was asserted from the beginning. His sporting uniqueness consisted especially in general talent and talent for ball games. He excelled especially in football, basketball, tennis, table tennis and at the end of his life since 2001 and golf, which completely failed. Ivan Hlinka left us prematurely in a tragic car accident on August 16, 2004. At three times the world champion and the most successful Czech national trener, who has been born since 70 years, relatives, teammates and friends. / V cyklu Příběhů slavných dnes máte možnost zhlednout dokument režisera Vladimíra Chrenovskeho o jedne z nejslavnějších osobností československeho a českeho hokeje – Ivanu Hlinkovi. Ke svemu prvnímu ligovemu utkání nastoupil ještě jako dorostenec ve svých šestnácti letech a mezi dospělými se prosazoval hned od počátku. Jeho sportovní výjimečnost spočívala zejmena ve všeobecnem nadání a v talentu pro míčove hry. Vynikal zejmena ve fotbalu, basketbalu, tenisu, stolnímu tenisu a ke konci života od roku 2001 i v golfu, kteremu zcela propadl. Ivan Hlinka nás opustil předčasně při tragicke automobilove nehodě 16. srpna 2004. Na trojnásobneho mistra světa a nejúspěšnějšího českeho reprezentačního trenera, od jehož narození uplyne v těchto dnech 70 let, vzpomínají příbuzní, spoluhráči a kamarádi.

programme.desc: In the next travel documents you will visit the ancient Lier. The drapery and trade flourished here, so the city boasts several architectural gems. Rococo town hall, Grote Markt with nice gable houses and other historical monuments. But if you have only a few tens of minutes to visit Lier, give them a visit to Zimmer's tower. Originally called Cornelius and fits into the Middle Ages. The new name received a local native, watchmaker and astronomer Louis Zimmer. He built two of his three masterpieces in the tower: jubilee clocks and astronomical studio with planetarium. The jubilee clock was constructed for 5 years and in 1930 donated them to Lier to stem the anniversary of the independence of Belgium. / V dalším z cestopisných dokumentů navštívíte starobylý Lier. Dařilo se tu soukenictví a obchodu, a tak se město může pochlubit několika architektonickými skvosty. Rokokovou radnicí, náměstím Grote Markt s pěknými štítovými domy a dalšími historickými památkami. Kdyby vám ale na prohlídku Lieru zbylo jen pár desítek minut, věnujte je návštěvě Zimmerovy věže. Původně se jmenovala Corneliova a zapadala do středověkeho opevnění. Nove jmeno dostala po místním rodákovi, hodináři a astronomovi Ludvíku Zimmerovi. Ten do věže vestavěl dva ze svých tří mistrovských kousků: jubilejní hodiny a astronomicke studio s planetáriem. Jubilejní hodiny Zimmer konstruoval 5 let a v roce 1930 je daroval městu Lieru ke stemu výročí samostatnosti Belgie.

We will set out on a breathtaking journey, which we will start at the wildly jagged mountain massifs and charming national parks and end up on the coast, in the region of idyllic villages. programme.title: The paths of faith / Cesty víry
programme.desc: In the chapel of Turin Cathedral of St. Since 1578, John the Baptist has been kept and guarded by an extraordinarily old and sacred relic. It is a linen fabric of 436 × 110 cm, which is said to have been shrouded in the body of Jesus Christ shortly after the crucifixion. The naked eye is visible on it the outline of a man high about 180 centimeters. Until now, no one has been satisfactorily explaining how this imprint originated. Scientists have been arguing for decades whether it is really a funeral reverse or a forgery of the Middle Ages. Either way, the Turin canvas raises respect, admiration and passions not only for believers. No wonder people have tried to make a copy of this unique work for centuries. There are about forty in the world. Until recently, the only one was in Central Europe. You can see in the Broumovsky monastery and it is said that it is one of the most successful. However, since this year's visitor season with the only faithful copy of the Turin screen in the world boasts the Archbishop's ... / V kapli turínske katedrály sv. Jana Křtitele je od roku 1578 uchovávána a střežena neobyčejně stará a posvátná relikvie. Jde o lněnou textilii o rozměrech 436×110 cm, o níž se traduje, že do ní bylo krátce po ukřižování zahaleno tělo Ježíše Krista. Pouhým okem jsou na ní viditelne obrysy muže vysokeho asi 180 centimetrů. Do dnešní doby nedokázal nikdo uspokojivě vysvětlit, jakým způsobem tento otisk vznikl. Vědci se už několik desítek let přou o to, zda jde skutečně o Kristův pohřební rubáš, nebo se jedná o podvrh z období středověku. Ať tak či tak, Turínske plátno vzbuzuje úctu, obdiv i vášně nejen u věřících. Není se tak co divit, že se lide po staletí snažili vyrobit kopii tohoto jedinečneho díla. Na světě jich existuje kolem čtyřiceti. Ve střední Evropě se donedávna nacházela jediná. K vidění je v broumovskem klášteře a říká se o ní, že patří k těm nejzdařilejším. Ovšem od letošní návštěvnicke sezony se jedinou věrnou kopií Turínskeho plátna na světě pyšní Arcibiskupský...

programme.title: Prayer on the river of Amazon / Ima az Amazonia folyoin
programme.desc: The films preserve the work of the Hungarian missionary, Franciscan monk in Vojvodina, who have been putting their life at the service of the Amazon indigenous people. Antal Zserdin, the named Geller, the leader of the San Ramon apostolic positions, founded a university, where they are educated by native young people to return to their own urgency with the power of knowledge and faith. Father Peter Dezső, in the Province of Perene, is a pastoral and charitable activity, and besides the announcement of the evangeli, it helps local families. The two missionary elaborations are closely shared with their personal past: the members of the Hungarians in Vojvodina themselves have experienced what the minority was to live in a country. This experience has made them open to the social and cultural lines of the Amazonian indigenous people. The film examines the meeting of faith, education and social responsibility through the service of two people. / A film ket vajdasági magyar misszionárius, ferences szerzetes perui munkásságát mutatja be, akik eletuket az amazoniai őslakos kozossegek szolgálatába állították. Zserdin Antal, rendi neven Gellert puspok, a San Ramon-i apostoli helynoksegenek vezetője egyetemet alapított, ahol az őslakos fiatalokat pedagogusokká kepezik, hogy visszaterve saját kozossegeikbe a tudás es a hit erejevel formálják jovőjuket. Dezső Peter atya a Perene tartományban vegez lelkipásztori es karitatív tevekenyseget, az evangelium hirdetese mellett konkret segítseget nyújtva a helyi családoknak. A ket misszionárius erzekenysege szorosan osszefugg szemelyes múltjukkal: a vajdasági magyarság tagjaikent maguk is megtapasztalták milyen a kisebbseg reszekent elni egy országban. Ez a tapasztalat tette őket kulonosen nyitottá az amazoniai őslakosok társadalmi es kulturális kuzdelmeire. A film a hit, az oktatás es a társadalmi felelőssegvállalás találkozását vizsgálja ket ember szolgálatán keresztul.

programme.title: October 7 - The fate of unity 414 / 7. Oktober - das Schicksal von Einheit 414
programme.desc: On October 7, it was two years ago that Hamas terrorist commands fell to the Suden Israel and the bloodiest massacre in the history of the country: more than 1200 Israelis were died, 251 people were delayed as hostages into the Gaza strip. programme.title: Hof Castle - Prince Eugen builds his dream / Schloss Hof - Prinz Eugen baut seinen Traum
programme.desc: He was the greatest of his time. He was one of the richest men of his time. And he was one of the greatest art collectors of his time. Prince Eugen of Savoy-Carignan acquired the 40 kilometers of Vienna in 1725 and began to transform the original Renaissance castle into a baroque palace complex. With the most basic planners, architects, garden designers and furniture designers - this was how it was described today. This "Experience Austria" from the ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (design: Barbara Baldauf, camera: Franz Cee) sets out for the search for traces for the man Prince Eugen, tries to scrape his passions to illuminate his theses and recognize his grade. For Prince Eugen nothing was too expensive and apparently nothing good enough. His winter palace and the Belvedere in Vienna still pay to the most impressive baroque buildings in the Esterreich capital. In Hof Castle he wanted to continue his dreams ... / Er war der groSSte Kriegsheld seiner Zeit. Er war einer der reichsten Manner seiner Zeit. Und er war einer der groSSten Kunstsammler seiner Zeit. Prinz Eugen von Savoyen-Carignan erwarb 1725 die 40 Kilometer ostlich von Wien gelegene Herrschaft Hof und begann das ursprungliche Renaissance-Kastell zu einer barocken Schlossanlage umzugestalten. Mit den beruhmtesten Planern, Architekten, Gartengestaltern und Mobeldesignern - so wurde man das heute bezeichnen. Dieses "Erlebnis Österreich" aus dem ORF Landesstudio Niederosterreich (Gestaltung: Barbara Baldauf, Kamera: Franz Cee) macht sich auf die Spurensuche nach dem Mann Prinz Eugen, versucht seine Leidenschaften zu ergrunden, seine Fahigkeiten zu beleuchten und seine Note zu erkennen. Fur Prinz Eugen war nichts zu teuer und scheinbar auch nichts gut genug. Sein Winterpalais und das Belvedere in Wien zahlen bis heute zu den beeindruckendsten Barockbauten der osterreichischen Hauptstadt. In Schloss Hof wollte er seine Traume weiter...

programme.title: Austrian picture / Österreich-Bild
programme.sub-title: Retten - Schutzen - Loschen - Bergen - 150 Jahre Landesfeuerwehrverband Vorarlberg
programme.desc: The first fire departments were founded in Vorarlberg in the mid -19th century. At that time it was primarily young men from gymnastics clubs who organized themselves to save people and fire. In order to develop and distribute the power, the "Vorarlberg Feuerwehrgauverband" was founded in 1875 to bundle and distribute them. This gradually developed from the "State Fire Brigade Association of Vorarlberg", which is now the hub for fire brigade in the country. The documentation of the ORF Vorarlberg illuminates the tasks of the State Fire Brigade Association and the training center in Feldkirch then and now. / In Vorarlberg wurden die ersten Feuerwehren Mitte des 19. Jahrhunderts gegrundet. Damals waren es in erster Linie junge Manner aus Turnvereinen, die sich organisierten, um Menschen zu retten und Brande zu loschen. Um die Krafte zu bundeln, Erfahrungen auszutauschen und Ausrustungen zu entwickeln und zu verteilen, wurde 1875 der "Vorarlberger Feuerwehrgauverband" gegrundet. Aus diesem entwickelte sich nach und nach der "Landesfeuerwehrverband Vorarlberg", der heute die Drehscheibe fur das Feuerwehrwesen im Land ist. Die Dokumentation des ORF Vorarlberg beleuchtet die Aufgaben des Landesfeuerwehrverbandes sowie das Ausbildungszentrum in Feldkirch damals und heute.

programme.title: The secret of health / Das Geheimnis der Gesundheit

Die Dokumentation von Andrea Eder geht neuen Ansatzen in der Medizin nach und hinterfragt den Einfluss, den Seele, Psyche, Lebenseinstellung und Religion auf die Gesundheit haben.

programme.title: The Habsburgs in Europe - from the dark of the time / Die Habsburger in Europa - Aus dem Dunkel der Zeit
programme.desc: The multi -part documentary series "The Habsburg in Europe" is a foray through the European history and the most beautiful and most important acts of the Habsburgs. The rise of the Habsburgers from a regional German ducal family from today's Alsace to the most powerful ruling dynasty in Europe is also reflected in the many structural certificates that are still reminiscent of their rise and its former power. The starting point of the cinematic journey into those Lander and to those places that are still characterized by the Habsburgs is the Vienna Hofburg. Based on the former center of power of the German-Roman emperors, the journey first goes west, Alsace and the Swiss canton of Aargau, where the gender of the Habsburgers entered the light of history around 900 years ago. R: Gernot Stadler / Die mehrteilige Dokumentationsreihe "Die Habsburger in Europa" ist ein Streifzug durch die europaische Geschichte und zu den schonsten und bedeutendsten Wirkstatten der Habsburger. Der Aufstieg der Habsburger von einer regionalen deutschen Herzogsfamilie aus dem heutigen Elsass zur machtigsten Herrscherdynastie Europas spiegelt sich auch in den vielen baulichen Zeugnissen, die heute noch an ihren Aufstieg und ihre einstige Macht erinnern. Ausgangspunkt der filmischen Reise in jene Lander und zu jenen Orten, die bis heute von den Habsburgern gepragt sind, ist die Wiener Hofburg. Ausgehend vom einstigen Machtzentrum der deutsch-romischen Kaiser fuhrt die Reise zunachst nach Westen, in das Elsass und den Schweizer Kanton Aargau, wo das Geschlecht der Habsburger vor rund 900 Jahren in das Licht der Geschichte tritt. R: Gernot Stadler

The 140 hectare area now pays to Austria's most spectacular nature conservation projects. Ornithologists have already documented 150 bird species in Weidmoos. The project sign of the project is the white star blue throat with 30 breeding pairs. There are also rare plants such as meadow orchids, devil claw, wool grass or sundew. In the film "Vogelparadies Weidmoos", in impressive images by cameraman Franz Schwaighofer, both the origin and biodiversity and the "habitat management" are shown in this former industrial wasteland in various seasons. / Das "Vogelparadies Weidmoos" liegt 20 Kilometer nordlich der Stadt Salzburg im Flachgau nahe der Grenze zu Oberosterreich. Das 140 Hektar groSSe Gebiet zahlt heute zu Österreichs spektakularsten Naturschutzprojekten. Ornithologen haben im Weidmoos mittlerweile bereits 150 Vogelarten dokumentiert. Aushangeschild des Projektes ist das weiSSsternige Blaukehlchen mit 30 Brutpaaren. Dazu kommen seltene Pflanzen wie Wiesenorchideen, Teufelskralle, Wollgras oder Sonnentau. In dem Film "Vogelparadies Weidmoos" werden in beeindruckenden Bildern von Kameramann Franz Schwaighofer sowohl die Entstehung als auch die Artenvielfalt und das "Habitatmanagment" in dieser ehemaligen Industriebrache in verschiedenen Jahreszeiten gezeigt.

programme.title: Culture today / Kultur heute

The well -known "enzis" serve as "bankerl". / Moderator Patrick Zwerger-Holder meldet sich mit Kultur Heute aus dem Naturhistorischen Museum Wien. programme.title: Work on the Alm - in the Styrian Alps / Arbeit auf der Alm - In den steirischen Alpen
programme.desc: Set up wood traps, set up bander fence, cut it in, look up, look after alpine horses - many professions on the Alm can usually only be done by hand today. It is a severe body work, not indiscriminate, but it leaves a day's work that people are proud of. Wolfgang Scherz and Werner Huemer accompanied several workers in the Styrian Alps on their daily activity. Among other things, they were at the ward manager Brendlalm, at the Harrer Huttenwirtin, at the wague, when swinging and taking a look into the past of the wooden servants. / Holzfallen, Banderzaune aufstellen, Gebusch zuruckschneiden, Almpferde betreuen - viele Berufe auf der Alm sind auch heute meistens nur von Hand zu erledigen. Es ist eine schwere korperliche Arbeit, nicht ungefahrlich, aber sie hinterlasst ein Tagwerk, auf das die Menschen stolz sind. programme.title: The magic of the Dolomites / Der Zauber der Dolomiten
programme.desc: The Tyrolean nature filmmaker Hans Jochler goes on a spectacular journey of discovery through the Dolomites for this "land of the mountains" production. The trip goes from the Geislerspitzen to the Gadertal. The spiritual tips are the heart of the Sudiroler Dolomites and landmarks of the Villnossertal. Alpine legend Reinhold Messner spent his childhood and youth here and completed his first attempts at climbing in the Wanden of the Dolomites. Villnoss is also known for the annual Sudirol bacon festival and the Vilnosser glasses sheep. In the Gadertal, in turn, the center of the centuries -old Ladin Culture, such as that of Grodner Schnitzkunst or the production of filigree handicrafts. The fan group, a huge mountain range, is also impressive due to its dolomite sagas, such as that of the "parliament of marmot", a high point of the documentation. / Fur diese "Land der Berge"- Produktion begibt sich der Tiroler Naturfilmer Hans Jochler auf eine spektakulare Entdeckungsreise durch die Dolomiten. Die Reise geht von den Geislerspitzen bis ins Gadertal. Die Geislerspitzen sind das Herzstuck der Sudtiroler Dolomiten und Wahrzeichen des Villnossertals. Alpinlegende Reinhold Messner verbrachte hier seine Kindheit und Jugend und absolvierte seine ersten Kletterversuche in den Wanden der Dolomiten. Bekannt ist Villnoss auch durch das jahrlich stattfindende Sudtiroler Speckfest und das Vilnosser Brillenschaf. Im Gadertal wiederum befindet sich das Zentrum der Jahrhunderte alten ladinischen Kultur, wie die der Grodner Schnitzkunst oder der Herstellung von filigranem Kunsthandwerk. Eindrucksvoll auch die Fanesgruppe, eine gewaltige Gebirgskette, beruhmt durch ihre Dolomitensagen, wie jener vom "Parlament der Murmeltiere", ein Hohepunkt der Dokumentation.

programme.title: The genius of nature / Das Genie der Natur
programme.desc: E01 Nature has the optimal solution for pretty much every technical problem. Evolution is building better and better - whether materials, combustion engines or navigation systems. This documentation about the wonderful world of Bionik shows how fading intelligently the construction plan of life can be. The show is devoted to the most tricky methods of locomotion: running, flying, swimming - why can animals do everything much better, faster and more economical than we do? A documentary by Alfred Vendl and Steve Nicholls / E01 Die Natur hat die optimale Losung fur so ziemlich jedes technische Problem parat. Die Evolution baut immer besser - ob Materialien, Verbrennungsmotoren oder Navigationssysteme. Wie verbluffend intelligent die Konstruktionsplane des Lebens sein konnen, zeigt diese Dokumentation uber die wunderbare Welt der Bionik. Die Sendung widmet sich den trickreichsten Methoden der Fortbewegung: Laufen, Fliegen, Schwimmen - wieso konnen Tiere alles viel besser, schneller und sparsamer als wir? Eine Dokumentation von Alfred Vendl und Steve Nicholls

programme.title: The genius of nature / Das Genie der Natur
programme.desc: E02 2nd episode: Material is all hard and yet elastic, as required, flexible or form -stable - the second episode of the series about the wonderful world of Bionik penetrates deep into the world of materials. It is only from Nachster, looking at electron microscopes, the materials of nature reveal where their incredible properties come from: whether the skin of sharks, the flight of a Morphhof age or the interior cladding of a snail shell, the evolution combines materials with a fading creativeity - to make them perfectly impact, power -grown or self -cleaning. A documentary by Alfred Vendl and Steve Nicholls / E02 2. Folge: Material ist alles Hart und doch elastisch, je nach Bedarf flexibel oder formstabil - die zweite Folge der Serie uber die wunderbare Welt der Bionik dringt tief in die Welt der Materialen ein. Erst aus nachster Nahe mit Elektronenmikroskopen betrachtet, verraten die Werkstoffe der Natur, woher ihre unglaublichen Eigenschaften stammen: Ob die Haut von Haien, die Flugel eines Morphofalters oder die Innenverkleidung eines Schneckenhauses, die Evolution kombiniert Materialien mit verbluffender Kreativitat - um sie perfekt schlagfest, stromungsgunstig oder selbstreinigend zu machen. Eine Dokumentation von Alfred Vendl und Steve Nicholls

programme.title: To table ... / Zu Tisch ...
programme.desc: E298 farmer Claudia Dollinger works on her farm near Nurnberg on the principle of solidarity agriculture. The members share the harvest, no matter how it fails. Because many products are ripe at the same time in autumn year, Claudia and her fellow campaigners specialize in fermentation: This old method of preserving makes fresh products with the help of bacteria over a long period of time without any valuable nutrients. This only takes salt, flow and time. Fermented tastes slightly acidic and is very healthy. At Claudia there is the classic sauerkraut, made of white and red cabbage. A regional specialty tastes: Frankish bratwursts. The Korean variant, Kimchi, can also be made with home herb, but is thrown differently. And as an experiment, Claudia's daughter Marlene Brownies bits with a fermented beetroot. / E298 Landwirtin Claudia Dollinger arbeitet auf ihrem Hof in der Nahe von Nurnberg nach dem Prinzip der solidarischen Landwirtschaft. Die Mitglieder teilen sich die Ernte, egal wie sie ausfallt. Weil im Herbst Jahr fur Jahr viele Produkte gleichzeitig reif sind, haben sich Claudia und ihre Mitstreiter aufs Fermentieren spezialisiert: Diese alte Methode des Konservierens macht frische Produkte mit Hilfe von Bakterien uber lange Zeitraume haltbar, ohne dass wertvolle Nahrstoffe verloren gehen. Dazu braucht es nur Salz, Flussigkeit und Zeit. Fermentiertes schmeckt leicht sauer und ist sehr gesund. Bei Claudia gibt es den Klassiker Sauerkraut, aus WeiSS- und aus Rotkraut. Dazu schmeckt eine regionale Spezialitat: frankische Bratwurste. Die koreanische Variante, Kimchi, lasst sich auch mit heimischem Kraut herstellen, wird aber anders gewurzt. Und als Experiment backt Claudias Tochter Marlene Brownies mit fermentierter Roter Bete.

programme.title: Julia - an unusual woman / Julia - Eine ungewohnliche Frau
programme.desc: S01E05 The Mahr family's farming farm is auctioned to the community, which wants to build a golf course in the country. The most important basic parameters for the construction, however, belong to Julia. The son of the post commandant attracts three Rottweiler and is seriously injured by the animals. / S01E05 Der verschuldete Bauernhof der Familie Mahr wird an die Gemeinde versteigert, die auf dem Gelande einen Golfplatz bauen will. Die fur den Bau wichtigste Grundstucksparzelle gehort jedoch Julia. Der Sohn des Postenkommandanten reizt drei Rottweiler und wird von den Tieren schwer verletzt.

programme.title: Julia - an unusual woman / Julia - Eine ungewohnliche Frau
programme.desc: S01E06 Julia sells its basic stucco savings to the municipality and transfers the money to the Mahr family. Ein auslandischer, illegaler Bauarbeiter verungluckt, der Baustellenleiter lasst die Leiche verschwinden. Carlos, der argentinische Vater von Julias Enkeln Elisabeth und Wolfgang, taucht wieder auf.

programme.title: Sudstyrian dream / Sudsteirische Traume
programme.desc: The gentle Hugel of Sudsteiermark and its originals are the focus of this ORF III new production. Directors Michael Weinmann meets the young wine -growing Lena Skringer, who is traveling her vines by bike departure - always accompanied by Hund Carlo. A detour leads to the Traussner Muhle, which is first mentioned in the 16th century and is still functional. Dieter Tatzl runs the 400 -year -old Muhle, in which he largely processes grain from his own cultivation. The four-headed hunting choir around Franz Straglgg-Leitner delivers musical moments. The Heiligengeistklamm near Leutschach inspires tourists like locals as a background location. Here Sabine Ertl and Manfred Stelzl from the mountain rescue guard ensure that the paths for everyone remain safe. / Die sanften Hugel der Sudsteiermark und ihre Originale stehen im Mittelpunkt dieser ORF III Neuproduktion. Regisseur Michael Weinmann trifft unter anderem die junge Weinbauerin Lena Skringer, die ihre Weinreben taglich mit dem Fahrrad abfahrt - stets begleitet von Hund Carlo. Ein Abstecher fuhrt zur Traussner Muhle, die erstmals im 16. Jahrhundert erwahnt und bis heute funktionstuchtig ist. Dieter Tatzl betreibt die 400 Jahre alte Muhle, in der er Getreide groSStenteils aus eigenem Anbau verarbeitet. Musikalische Momente liefert der vierkopfige Jagerchor rund um Franz Strablegg-Leitner. Die Heiligengeistklamm bei Leutschach begeistert als Ruckzugsort Touristen wie Einheimische. Hier sorgen Sabine Ertl und Manfred Stelzl von der Bergwacht dafur, dass die Wege fur alle sicher begehbar bleiben.

programme.title: Life in the hesitation / Leben im Gesause
programme.desc: The Enns becomes a Sturzbach on sixteen kilometers to Admont - their roaring roar gave this region the name of Gesause. In this shot and rustic part of Styria, designer Christian Papke has portrayed typical people in the region for this country life. The Schuhplattler Group Landl has designed its own Schuhplattler, where they always throw one of them high. After the rehearsal of the dance, everyone can take a rafting tour into the Salza, the cohesion is everything, and most of the group are also together with the fire brigade. The water hole gorge in the nearby water hole is also very popular with the locals. The Veitlbauer needs the orchards for his schnapps. The hunting horn bladers come tasted and thank you with a stale. The Kolblalm alpine farmer is baking when the Brodjaga stops by a visit. In Johnsbach, various folk musicians travel to the Kolblwirt to ... / Auf sechzehn Kilometer nach Admont wird die Enns zum Sturzbach - ihr tosendes Brausen gab dieser Region den Namen Gesause. In diesem zerklufteten und urigen Teil der Steiermark hat Gestalter Christian Papke fur diese Landleben Neuproduktion typische Menschen der Region portratiert. Die Schuhplattler-Gruppe Landl hat einen eigenen Schuhplattler entworfen, wo sie einen von ihnen immer hoch in die Luft werfen. Nach der Probe des Tanzes kuhlen sich alle in den Salza bei einer Rafting-Tour ab, der Zusammenhalt ist alles, und die meisten der Gruppe sind auch beruflich gemeinsam bei der Feuerwehr. Die in der Nahe gelegene Wasserlochklamm ist auch bei den Einheimischen sehr beliebt. Die Streuobstwiesen braucht der Veitlbauer fur seinen Schnaps. Die Jagdhornblaser kommen verkosten und bedanken sich mit einem Standchen. Die Almwirtin der Kolblalm ist am Backen, als die Brodjaga auf einen Besuch vorbeischauen. In Johnsbach reisen diverse Volksmusiker beim Kolblwirt an, um gemeinsam zu...

programme.title: From Schilcherland to the changing country / Vom Schilcherland ins Wechselland
programme.desc: E01 Styria - that is scenic wealth from the rock massif to the juicy alpine pasture, from the wine area to the waterfall. The Styrian director Alfred Ninaus has captured the cheapest places in film and gives insights into the diversity of the federal state. The journey begins in the southern western Styria in the municipality of Wies. There is fascinating the play of colors of a waterfall that rushes into the white Sulm. Anyone who liked to know how grain was processed into flour will get their money's worth in the Muhle Strutz. We continue to the Eibiswald region, where you can find the picturesque reservoir Soboth, the Dreeckalm and the power tree on the Turmkogel. In Schilcherland it goes over the Stainz Castle to Schilcher Weinstrasse. Here Styrian Buschenschanken pretend against a unique backdrop. When you drive the colorful Stainz Flascherlzug, you can look at the picturesque valley of the Stainzbach. Other treasures are the St. Barbara Church in Barnbach, ... / E01 Steiermark - das ist landschaftlicher Reichtum vom Felsmassiv bis zur saftigen Alm, vom Weingebiet bis zum Wasserfall. Der steirische Regisseur Alfred Ninaus hat die schonsten Orte filmisch eingefangen und gibt Einblicke in die Vielfalt des Bundeslandes. Die Reise beginnt in der sudlichen Weststeiermark in der Gemeinde Wies. Dort fasziniert das Farbenspiel eines Wasserfalls, der in die Weisse Sulm rauscht. Wer wissen mochte, wie Getreide fruher zu Mehl verarbeitet wurde, kommt in der Strutz Muhle auf seine Kosten. Weiter geht es in die Region Eibiswald, wo man den malerischen Stausee Soboth, die Dreieckalm und dem Kraftbaum am Turmkogel vorfindet. Im Schilcherland geht es uber das Schloss Stainz zur Schilcher WeinstraSSe. Hier prasentieren sich steirische Buschenschanken vor einer einzigartigen Kulisse. Bei einer gemutlichen Fahrt mit dem bunten Stainzer Flascherlzug blickt man auf das pittoreske Tal des Stainzbaches. Weitere Schatze sind die St. Barbara Kirche in Barnbach,...

programme.title: Round of editors / Runde der ChefredakteurInnen
programme.desc: Budget -related pension adjustments, carnival salary closures for civil servants: at least politically, Austria is facing a hot autumn. The large -scale reform of social assistance also does not reveal a clear direction. In addition, the triple coalition continues to seek recipes against the high inflation, increased unemployment and the weak economy. And the government also weakens with the survey values. How does the coalition act in fact? And how convincing does the opposition work? Maria Scholl (Austria Press Agency), Martina Salomon (Kurier), Anna Thalhammer (profile), Gerold Riedmann (Der Standard) and Christian Nusser (today-Verlag) are guests in a "round of editors" at ORF-III editor-in-chief Louz-Dittlbacher. / Budgetbedingte Pensionsanpassungen, aufgeschnurte Gehaltsabschlusse fur Beamte: Zumindest politisch steht Österreich ein heiSSer Herbst bevor. Auch die groSS angekundigte Reform der Sozialhilfe lasst noch keine klare Richtung erkennen. Daruber hinaus sucht die Dreierkoalition weiterhin Rezepte gegen die hohe Inflation, die gestiegene Arbeitslosigkeit und die schwache Konjunktur. Und auch bei den Umfragewerten schwachelt die Regierung. Wie schlagt sich die Koalition tatsachlich? Und wie uberzeugend arbeitet die Opposition? In einer "Runde der ChefredakteurInnen" bei ORF-III-Chefredakteurin Lou Lorenz-Dittlbacher zu Gast sind Maria Scholl (Austria Presse Agentur), Martina Salomon (Kurier), Anna Thalhammer (profil), Gerold Riedmann (Der Standard) und Christian Nusser (Heute-Verlag).

programme.title: Where do the USA are going? / Wohin steuern die USA?
programme.desc: Where do the USA are going? Under this title, the Austrian-American Society laid a discussion with the burial leaders of the ORF Buros in Washington D.C. the last decades. How have the United States changed in the past few decades and where do you go to Donald Trump's prasidacy? Under the moderation of Roland Adrowitzer: Barbara Wolschek, Hanno Settele, Hannelore Veit, Peter Fritz, Thomas Langpaul and Eugen Freund. / Wohin steuern die USA? Unter diesem Titel ladt die Österreichisch-Amerikanische Gesellschaft zu einer Diskussion mit den Buroleiterinnen und Buroleitern des ORF-Buros in Washington D.C. der letzten Jahrzehnte. Wie haben sich die USA in den letzten Jahrzehnten verandert und wohin steuern sie unter der Prasidentschaft von Donald Trump? Es diskutieren unter der Moderation von Roland Adrowitzer: Barbara Wolschek, Hanno Settele, Hannelore Veit, Peter Fritz, Thomas Langpaul und Eugen Freund.

programme.title: Bohmerwald - wilderness in the heart of Europe / Bohmerwald - Wildnis im Herzen Europas

Heute umschlieSSen Nationalparks die geschutzten Bereiche des Bohmerwaldes an den Grenzen Oberosterreichs, Bayerns und Tschechiens. Walder, Seen und Moore beherrschen die Landschaft, in der wieder Luchse, Wolfe und vereinzelt sogar Elche ihre Heimat gefunden haben. At this time, the dream of a family of more families has become a dream. In the previous year, 6 families have changed with the help of the show, and in the current episodes, there are many exciting, vigorous moments and unexpected turns. Every week, the redesigner's blacksmiths can trace a new family cake, who then move into their home -made homes. / S02E03 Az Ördog Nora műsorvezetesevel folytatodo szeriában profi szakemberek ismet olyan rászorulo családok otthonát alakítják át, akiknek onerejukből nem lenne lehetőseguk változtatni korulmenyeiken. Iden az eddigieknel is tobb család álma válik valora. Az előző evadban 6 család elete változott meg a műsor segítsegevel, es a mostani epizodokban is számos izgalmas, erzelmes pillanatra es nem várt fordulatra számíthatnak a nezők. Az Újratervezes kovetői minden heten egy új család tortenetet kíserhetik nyomon, akik penteken aztán be is koltoznek újjávarázsolt otthonukba.
